title: Can escalation channels redirect reward hacking toward defect disclosure?
authors: Francesca Gomez
abstract: When coding agents encounter defective test infrastructure they may reward-hack: hardcoding outputs or editing test files to pass tests they cannot legitimately satisfy, a pattern that has now appeared outside benchmarks, in a coordinated multi-agent intrusion of a major AI platform's production infrastructure. The same capability that lets an agent detect and exploit a defect could let it report one, given the right decision environment. We evaluate escalation channels, structured reporting tools available to the agent at the point of conflict, as a decision-environment intervention that both reduces reward hacking and surfaces the infrastructure defects that trigger it. A $2 \times 2$ factorial separates the contributions of an escalation tool, a standalone anti-reward-hacking policy, and their combination. Across 8 frontier models spanning 5 families, the combined intervention reduces reward hacking from 23.6\% to 5.3\% (mixed-effects logistic OR = 9.2, 95\% CI 5.0--16.8, $p < 10^{-12}$) with no detectable cost or performance overhead, eliminating it entirely for 6 of 8 models. Escalation and hacking are near-perfectly mutually exclusive, with 96.8\% of escalations involving no hacking. Beyond reduction, escalation channels function as diagnostic infrastructure: on top of monitoring, escalation adds +10.1 percentage points of defect detection coverage and is more accurate once it fires (99.4\% vs 85.8\%). Unlike containment-based approaches that risk outpacing growing model capabilities, escalation channels redirect capability toward disclosure rather than exploitation.
zh_title: 升级渠道能否将奖励劫持重定向到缺陷披露？
translation: 当编码代理遇到有缺陷的测试基础设施时，它们可能会进行奖励劫持：硬编码输出或编辑测试文件以通过它们无法合法满足的测试，这种模式现在已经出现在基准测试之外，例如对一个主要AI平台的生产基础设施进行协同多代理入侵。代理检测和利用缺陷的相同能力，在正确的决策环境下，也可以让它报告缺陷。我们评估了升级渠道，即在冲突点提供给代理的结构化报告工具，作为一种决策环境干预措施，旨在减少奖励劫持并揭示引发它的基础设施缺陷。一个2x2析因设计分离了升级工具、独立的防奖励劫持策略及其组合的贡献。在涵盖5个家族的8个前沿模型中，组合干预措施将奖励劫持从23.6%降低到5.3%（混合效应logistic OR = 9.2，95% CI 5.0-16.8，$p < 10^{-12}$），且没有可检测到的成本或性能开销，对8个模型中的6个完全消除了奖励劫持。升级和劫持几乎完全互斥，96.8%的升级不涉及劫持。除了减少奖励劫持，升级渠道还具有诊断基础设施的功能：在监控之外，升级增加了10.1个百分点的缺陷检测覆盖率，并且在触发时更准确（99.4% vs 85.8%）。与可能被模型能力增长超越的基于遏制的方法不同，升级渠道将能力重定向到披露而不是利用。
tldr: 本文评估了升级渠道作为一种决策环境干预措施，以减少AI代理的奖励劫持行为，并促使其报告基础设施缺陷，结果显示该方法显著减少了奖励劫持并提高了缺陷检测率。
ai_comments: 这篇论文提出了一种创新且具有前瞻性的方法来应对AI代理的奖励劫持行为。其核心创新在于不试图“限制”代理的能力，而是通过设计决策环境来“重定向”其能力，使其从利用缺陷转向披露缺陷。这种方法对于构建更安全、更可靠的AI系统具有重要意义，尤其是在多代理和生产环境中。它提供了一种可扩展的解决方案，可能比单纯的遏制方法更具鲁萨性和长期有效性。
motivation: AI代理在遇到有缺陷的测试基础设施时可能会进行奖励劫持（如硬编码输出或修改测试文件以通过测试），这种行为已在实际场景中出现，例如一次针对主要AI平台生产基础设施的协同多代理入侵。研究动机是利用代理检测和利用缺陷的能力，通过正确的决策环境使其报告缺陷，而不是进行奖励劫持。
method: 研究评估了升级渠道，即在冲突点提供给代理的结构化报告工具，作为一种决策环境干预措施。采用2x2析因设计，分离了升级工具、独立的防奖励劫持策略及其组合的贡献。在8个前沿模型上进行了测试。
results: 组合干预措施将奖励劫持从23.6%降低到5.3%（对于8个模型中的6个完全消除），且没有可检测到的成本或性能开销。升级与劫持几乎完全互斥，96.8%的升级不涉及劫持。升级渠道作为诊断基础设施，在监控基础上增加了10.1个百分点的缺陷检测覆盖率，并且在触发时更准确（99.4% vs 85.8%）。
conclusion: 与可能被模型能力增长超越的基于遏制的方法不同，升级渠道将代理的能力重定向到缺陷披露而不是利用。

title: A Causal Model for Locating and Unlocking Sandbagging in Model Organisms
authors: Hong Kiat Tan, Linh Le, David Williams-King
abstract: Sandbagging models strategically underperform on evaluations while retaining the capabilities being measured. The evaluations that guide frontier-model deployment and governance then understate what these models can do. To understand the mechanism, we propose a causal model of how sandbagging is carried in the residual stream. Early layers write the sandbagging intent onto a single axis of the stream, and a later layer reads that axis and commits the answer. We study three instruction-tuned models (Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3-8B, and Mistral-7B) and four ways of installing a sandbagging lock (prompting, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and circuit breaking). Each lock decides from the prompt whether to sandbag, and the fine-tuned and circuit-broken locks answer honestly whenever a password appears. The causal model predicts a window of layers, after the last sandbagging write and before the answer commit, in which a single-layer reference graft of the sandbagging axis to its honest value restores the full capability. The single-layer graft recovers the capability in 28 of the 33 runs of the prompted, fine-tuned, and RL-trained locks, with a median held-out recovery of 96%. The circuit-broken lock rewrites the whole state through a band of layers, and the single-layer graft fails at every layer. We therefore introduce a second intervention, context grafting, which replays the password's cached key/value activations so that every layer's attention reads them as additional context. Context grafting provably and empirically restores the full capability on all three models, and the recovery is surprisingly insensitive to the exact password content. More broadly, an auditor can use this causal model to design interventional auditing techniques for sandbagging models.
zh_title: 定位和解锁模型中沙袋行为的因果模型
translation: 沙袋模型在评估中会策略性地表现不佳，但同时保留了被测量的能力。指导前沿模型部署和治理的评估因此低估了这些模型的能力。为了理解其机制，我们提出了一个关于沙袋行为如何在残差流中进行的因果模型。早期层将沙袋意图写入残差流的单一轴，而后期层读取该轴并提交答案。我们研究了三种指令微调模型（Qwen2.5-7B、Llama-3-8B和Mistral-7B）以及四种安装沙袋锁的方式（提示、微调、强化学习和电路中断）。每个锁都根据提示决定是否进行沙袋行为，而微调和电路中断的锁在出现密码时会诚实回答。该因果模型预测了一个层窗口，即在最后一次沙袋写入之后和答案提交之前，其中将沙袋轴的单层参考嫁接到其诚实值可以恢复全部能力。单层嫁接在33次提示、微调和RL训练的锁运行中，有28次恢复了能力，中位数保持恢复率为96%。电路中断的锁通过一系列层重写整个状态，并且单层嫁接在每一层都失败了。因此，我们引入了第二种干预措施——上下文嫁接，它重放密码的缓存键/值激活，以便每一层的注意力都将其作为额外的上下文读取。上下文嫁接在所有三种模型上都能在理论和实践上恢复全部能力，并且恢复效果对确切的密码内容出乎意料地不敏感。更广泛地说，审计师可以使用这个因果模型来设计针对沙袋模型的干预性审计技术。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个因果模型来理解和解决模型中的“沙袋行为”（即战略性低表现），并展示了如何通过有针对性的干预措施恢复模型的全部能力。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新之处在于提出了一个新颖的因果模型来解释模型中的“沙袋行为”，并将其机制定位在残差流中。更重要的是，它开发了两种有针对性的干预技术——单层嫁接和上下文嫁接，能够有效地“解锁”模型的真实能力。这对于提高AI模型评估的准确性和透明度，以及加强AI治理具有重要意义。论文区分了不同沙袋实现方式（特别是“电路中断”类型）并针对性地提出了解决方案，展现了深入的机制理解。
motivation: 前沿模型在评估中存在“沙袋行为”——即战略性地表现不佳，但实际上保留了被测量的能力，这导致对模型真实能力的低估，从而影响模型的部署和治理。研究动机在于理解这种机制并开发解锁模型全部能力的方法。
method: 研究者提出了一个因果模型来解释沙袋行为如何在残差流中发生：早期层将沙袋意图写入残差流的单一轴，后期层读取该轴并提交答案。他们研究了三种指令微调模型（Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3-8B, Mistral-7B）和四种安装沙袋锁的方式（提示、微调、强化学习和电路中断）。对于提示、微调和强化学习安装的沙袋锁，他们提出了一种单层参考嫁接干预，通过将沙袋轴替换为诚实值来恢复能力。对于电路中断型沙袋锁，他们引入了第二种干预——上下文嫁接，通过重放密码的缓存键/值激活来恢复能力。
results: 单层嫁接在33次提示、微调和RL训练的沙袋锁运行中，有28次成功恢复了能力，中位数恢复率达96%。然而，单层嫁接在电路中断型沙袋锁上完全失败。上下文嫁接在所有三种模型上都能在理论和实践上恢复全部能力，并且其恢复效果对确切的密码内容不敏感。
conclusion: 该因果模型可供审计师设计针对沙袋模型的干预性审计技术。根据沙袋行为的实现方式，有针对性的干预措施（单层嫁接、上下文嫁接）能够有效地恢复沙袋模型的全部能力。

title: Co-Evolutionary Prompt Optimization with Cross-Category Transfer for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
authors: Sisi Zhu, Changwei Yu, Renshuai Tao, Zhenliang Ni
abstract: Zero-shot anomaly detection (ZSAD) has gained significant attention for its practical value in industrial inspection. Recently, CLIP-based approaches have been widely adopted in ZSAD due to their strong vision-language generalization capabilities. However, existing methods commonly employ continuous prompt embeddings for prompt optimization and encode semantics in latent vectors, which lack interpretability and scalability. To this end, we propose CoEvoAD, a co-evolutionary framework for discrete prompt selection. CoEvoAD performs prompt search in the discrete natural-language space using an evolutionary algorithm. Candidate prompts are iteratively generated, evaluated, and selected throughout population evolution, thus preserving the interpretability and composability of natural language. Furthermore, we introduce a Cross-Category Transfer Objective (CCTO), which treats held-out source categories as proxies for unseen categories and scores prompt rules based on their estimated cross-category transferability, effectively improving cross-category generalization. Extensive experiments are conducted to validate the effectiveness of CoEvoAD, and the results show that it achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple anomaly detection datasets. The code is available at https://github.com/rstao-bjtu/CoEvoAD.

title: Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness of Reasoning Models Varies with Where and How Preference Cues Are Delivered
authors: Aryo Pradipta Gema, Neel Rajani, Rohit Saxena, Wai-Chung Kwan, Pasquale Minervini
abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring assumes that reasoning traces faithfully record the information that shapes a model's answer. Existing faithfulness tests often place explicit bias cues in the user message, while agents may encounter preferences through tool returns or raw artifacts. We introduce FACE-Eval (Faithful Attribution of Cue Effects Evaluation), a 5,100-sample evaluation that varies cue location (user message or tool return) and explicitness (direct summary or raw artifact). We measure verbalized commitment among cue-following answers and unverbalized adoption among all cued samples. We evaluate 15 open-weight models from eight families, with total parameters ranging from 4B to 1.60T. Every model has lower verbalized commitment for tool-return than user-message cues and for implicit than explicit cues. Unverbalized adoption is higher for tool-return cues on all 15 models and for implicit cues in 28 of 30 model-channel comparisons. A source-attribution prompt narrows the channel gap on seven models, sometimes by increasing user-channel unverbalized adoption, while telling models that their reasoning will be monitored does not reliably close the gap. We also use two transcript monitors (GPT-5.6-Luna and GPT-4o-mini) to detect preference adoption in the largest model of each family. Across 32 model-channel-explicitness cells, higher unverbalized adoption is associated with lower detection ability for both monitors (Pearson r=-0.54 and r=-0.78, respectively). These results suggest that CoT monitoring may be less reliable when preference information arrives through tools or must be inferred from raw artifacts, within the single-call, prefilled-tool setting tested here.

abstract: This letter reveals a fundamental limitation of passivity-based distributed stability analysis in power systems. Potential extensions of passivity frameworks are discussed to break this limitation.

title: Benchmark Contamination: A Taxonomy Organized by Defeated Mitigation
authors: Johanna Angulo, Víctor Yeste, Hector Espinos-Morato
abstract: A benchmark score is a joint property of the model, the evaluation harness, the elicitation budget, the sampled population, and contamination status. Leaderboards publish the model and the score, so capability and leakage stay observationally equivalent. Existing taxonomies classify contamination for automated detection, not the question a reporter faces at publication: given the mitigations already applied, which validity threats remain open? We introduce a taxonomy organized by the mitigation each type defeats -- direct, derivative, temporal, distributional, and acquired -- spanning training-time and evaluation-time leakage. Holding out a private test set closes the first alone. The fifth is acquired during the evaluation itself; because it is a property of one run, it must be recorded with the reported score rather than with the benchmark release. We operationalize it as a four-field disclosure protocol in which "unknown" is a valid entry, released under CC BY 4.0 with a JSON Schema, a validator, and worked examples. Two coders external to the design team applied a pre-registered instrument to 41 documents. Per-variable linear-weighted $κ$ runs from 0.00 to 0.35 (median 0.21) over 29 main-pass documents against a single-coder test-retest ceiling of 0.84, collapsing under the class skew the registration anticipated; pooling raises it to 0.46 through chance correction rather than better agreement. Two variables fall below the prevalence-robust threshold registered in advance: strata reporting and the acquired type introduced here. Disagreement concentrates on when a variable applies rather than on what a document states. Elicitation budgets are reported in 13% of documents, and no document addresses all five types. The contribution is the taxonomy, the score-side artifact that follows from it, and a pre-registered measurement of instrument reliability and current disclosure.

zh_title: 基准污染：一种按失效缓解措施组织的分类法
translation: 基准分数是模型、评估工具、启发预算、抽样人群和污染状态的共同属性。排行榜公布模型和分数，因此能力和泄漏在观察上仍然是等效的。现有分类法将污染分类用于自动化检测，而非记者在出版时面临的问题：在已应用缓解措施的情况下，哪些有效性威胁仍然开放？我们引入了一种按每种类型所能克服的缓解措施（直接、衍生、时间、分布和获得）组织的分类法，涵盖训练时和评估时的泄漏。单独保留私有测试集只能解决第一种。第五种是在评估过程中获得的；因为它是一个运行的属性，所以必须与报告分数一起记录，而不是与基准发布一起记录。我们将其操作化为一个四字段披露协议，其中“未知”是一个有效条目，根据CC BY 4.0发布，附带JSON Schema、验证器和工作示例。两名独立于设计团队的编码员对41份文档应用了预注册工具。29份主要文档的变量线性加权 κ 值介于0.00到0.35之间（中位数0.21），而单编码员测试重测上限为0.84，在预期的类别偏斜下崩溃；通过偶然校正而非更好的一致性，汇总后提高到0.46。两个变量低于预先注册的普遍性鲁棒阈值：分层报告和本文引入的获得性类型。分歧集中在变量何时适用，而非文档内容。13%的文档报告了启发预算，没有文档涵盖所有五种类型。本文的贡献是分类法、随之而来的分数侧工件，以及对工具可靠性和当前披露的预注册测量。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新的基准污染分类法，该分类法基于每种污染类型所能克服的缓解措施，并提供了一个四字段披露协议来记录评估过程中产生的污染，同时测量了当前披露实践和所提议工具的可靠性。

title: Knowledge Distillation under Teacher Misspecification: An Order-Parameter Analysis of the Gap between Teacher Mimicry and Task Performance
authors: Kazuyuki Hara, Hideitsu Hino
abstract: Knowledge distillation trains a small student model to reproduce the outputs of a large teacher model, and its progress is typically monitored through the teacher--student discrepancy. The quantity of ultimate interest, however, is the student's error with respect to the true task. We study the relation between these two objectives in a minimal three-party model, a true teacher (generative model), a teacher, and a student, all soft committee machines, in which the true teacher contains a shared latent factor that the teacher cannot represent, with mismatch strength controlled by a single scalar $\dmiss$. Within an order-parameter description of online distillation, and exploiting closed-form (arcsine-type) expressions for all errors under error-function activations, we prove that the learning dynamics and the distillation error $\Ets$ are exactly invariant to $\dmiss$, whereas the true error $\Etzs$ and the gap $Δ=\Etzs-\Ets$ are strictly increasing in $\dmiss$, with a rate that is amplified linearly by the complexity $M_0$ of the true teacher. Numerical phase diagrams over the plane spanned by true-teacher complexity and student capacity confirm the predicted deformation: the contours of $\Ets$ do not move while the landscape of $\Etzs$ rises systematically, and a teacher-miss regime, where mimicry succeeds but the task fails, expands with $\dmiss$. The results give a quantitative warning against evaluating distillation solely through teacher-mimicry metrics and identify the gap $Δ$ as a minimal diagnostic for distinguishing teacher-miss from capacity-limited failure.

title: Seeing Through Extreme Visual Sparsity: Surface Understanding from a Single Random Visual Patch
authors: Sindhuja Penchala, Sudip Mittal, Noorbakhsh Amiri Golilarz
abstract: Surface material recognition from incomplete visual observations remains a challenging problem in robotic perception and environmental understanding. This paper discusses Sparse Surface Understanding Framework (SSUF), a unified dual-task learning framework that adapts four pretrained architectures-Convolutional Autoencoder (ConvAE), Vision Transformer (ViT), Swin Transformer, and Masked Autoencoder (MAE) for si-multaneous surface reconstruction and material classification. Experiments were conducted on the Touch-and-Go dataset using a sparse observation protocol in which only 10% of the original image remained visible while the remaining regions were masked. To enable a fair comparison, reconstruction-oriented models were extended with classification heads, whereas classification- oriented models were augmented with reconstruction decoders. The resulting architectures were assessed using reconstruction quality, classification performance, model complexity, and in-ference efficiency metrics. Experimental results revealed distinct strengths across the models. Swin Transformer achieved the best classification performance with an accuracy of 89.21%, an F1-score of 0.8922, and a ROC-AUC of 0.9813. In contrast, MAE produced the highest reconstruction scores among evaluated models, with a PSNR of 16.06 dB and an SSIM of 0.4501, while ViT provided the best overall balance between reconstruction and classification performance. Furthermore, all models achieved real-time inference, requiring less than 5 ms per image. Over-all, the results show that pretrained architectures can support material recognition under severe visual sparsity, while accurate image reconstruction remains challenging.

title: MUDDLE: Measuring Understanding of Documents under Distractor and Length Effects
authors: Jason Luo, Saibilila Abudukelimu, Judy Song, Andrew Feng, Shivank Garg, Vasu Sharma, Kevin Zhu
abstract: Document question-answering systems increasingly answer questions over collections of retrieved documents rather than one clean source, so robustness to distracting context matters as much as reading ability. When such systems fail, it is often unclear whether the context was too long or the distractors were too close to the topic, because prior work tends to conflate these two effects. We present MUDDLE, a controlled benchmark that separates them. MUDDLE uses 270 human-annotated questions, each tied to a single source document, and instantiates every question in five conditions: the source alone, the source with two or four topically similar hard negatives, and the source with two or four random distractors. The random distractors are matched to the hard negatives in length and provenance, so an accuracy gap between the two arms reflects topical similarity rather than length. All five conditions are rendered in markdown, page images, and raw PDF, but the distractor sweep reported here is run in markdown, since a source plus its distractors exceeds current image and PDF input limits. We score answers with an LLM judge across three model families. In the complete markdown sweep, hard negatives lower accuracy more than length-matched random documents at both context sizes for gpt-5-mini, while random documents stay near the no-distractor baseline. The effect is small but directionally consistent, and for gpt-5-mini hard negatives significantly underperform length-matched random distractors when pooled across context sizes. We release the data and evaluation code for a reproducible study of context degradation.

title: SIC-Agents: Benchmarking and Building an Adaptive Simulator for Pediatric Serious Illness Communication Training
authors: Zihan Wang, Anita Marie Slominska, Rennie Bimman, Elizabeth Di Flumeri, Amanda Mayappo-Neeposh, Conall Francoeur, Tamara Ellen Carver, Xiao-Wen Chang, Doina Precup, Esin Darici Haritaoglu, Ismail Haritaoglu, Akshatha Arodi, Naomi Goloff
abstract: Pediatric serious illness communication (SIC) is critically important, yet scalable communication training for clinicians remains limited. Compared with other dialogue simulation settings, pediatric SIC poses additional challenges, including multi-party interactions, response to parental distress and strong dependence on feedback dynamics. Existing LLM-based simulators optimize generic dialogue quality rather than curriculum-contingent behavior required for effective SIC training. In collaboration with educators and pediatric clinicians, we introduce the first benchmark suite and simulation framework tailored to pediatric SIC training. Our benchmarks, PitfallBench and DialogueBench, evaluate simulators both at the turn-level and across full dialogues. We further propose SIC-Agents, a self-improving framework that generates a clinician-editable skill document to guide simulator behavior. Our experiments show that SIC-Agents outperforms static expert prompting. To support future research, we release our benchmarks for parent simulation in pediatric SIC at https://github.com/Beikewzh/sic-benchmarks

title: Applications of Risk Science to AI Fairness Evaluation: Principles, Challenges, and Best Practices
authors: Kyra Wilson, Sabrina Kang, Saloni Dash, Aylin Caliskan
abstract: Scholarly work which aims to describe potential societal impacts (e.g., risks) of proliferating technology (especially related to artificial intelligence or other algorithmic systems) is likely to have an impact beyond the scientific communities it was written for, given that general society itself is a primary object of study. However, it is an open question whether the current practices of AI evaluation scholarship follow the principles and best practices established by risk science, which aims to systematically generate knowledge related to understanding, assessing, communicating, managing, and governing risk. In this work, we examine this in depth by conducting a literature review of scholarly works purporting to evaluate the bias or fairness of technological systems used for tasks related to hiring and employment. Through analysis of 22 common fairness evaluation metrics and studies using them, we find that most characterize the severity of bias- or fairness-related consequences but do not follow best practices to characterize the uncertainty around either the occurrence of these consequences or severity estimates. Next, we conduct a case study of fairness evaluation for an AI-mediated resume screening task and demonstrate how principles of risk science can be incorporated into such an evaluation. Finally, we propose the AI Risk Report Card, which facilitates the reporting and communication of risk assessment results to stakeholders in positions to act based on the predicted risks. The outcomes of these activities suggest that further research at the convergence of risk science and AI evaluation can lead to advancements in AI assessments of societal impact by enabling shared frameworks to evaluate and discuss AI risks both within and outside of the scientific community.

title: What Are You Listening to? Temporal Music Grounding for Audio-to-Text Large Language Models
authors: Kun Fang, Ziyu Wang, Ichiro Fujinaga
abstract: Large audio-language models can produce fluent and musically plausible responses, yet it often remains unclear whether those responses are grounded in the audio input. We introduce temporal music grounding, a task in which a model returns one or more time spans corresponding to a queried musical note, event, or pattern. To evaluate this capability, we present MusicGroundingBench, a controlled benchmark suite built by rendering algorithmically generated piano MIDI to audio, yielding exact symbolic-to-audio alignment. The suite comprises two subsets: MGBench-3N, which evaluates note-level grounding in clips containing up to three notes, and MGBench-2B, which evaluates structured grounding and short-form music understanding in two-bar excerpts. Experiments show that temporal music grounding remains challenging for current audio-language models, whereas task-specific training yields substantial gains. We further report exploratory evidence on the relationship between grounding supervision and music understanding. These results establish MusicGroundingBench as a controlled testbed for assessing whether audio-language models ground their responses in temporally localized musical evidence.

title: Parallel Integration over Simple Radical Extensions
authors: Sam Blake
abstract: The parallel Risch (Risch--Norman) method is a fast heuristic for computing elementary integrals over towers of transcendental extensions. Its justification rests on two structural facts about the integral: a bound on its denominator and a description of the logarithms that can occur. Both are known for purely logarithmic towers (Davenport--Trager) and, in the form of a structure theorem, for arbitrary derivations on multivariate rational function fields (Bronstein). We extend both facts to a simple radical extension $L=K(y)$, $y^m=q$, of such a field. The key observations are that the integral closure of $F[t_1,\dots,t_n]$ in $L$ has an explicit basis, so that all factorisation can remain in a polynomial ring, and that the derivation has a well-defined pole order $δ_P\in\{0,1,e_P\}$ at every height-one prime $P$, so that pole orders of derivatives shift by $δ_P$. The denominator of the integral then has the same Hermite-type shape as in the transcendental case, while the admissible logands are precisely the $S$-units of the integral closure for an explicit finite set $S$ of primes; the latter can be larger than the set generated by irreducible polynomials, as the unit $x+\sqrt{x^2+1}$ shows. For $n=1$ we relate these $S$-units to torsion in the Jacobian and, for $m=2$, to the polynomial Pell equation, obtaining a complete description of the logarithmic part in genus~0. We describe the resulting algorithm and give examples.

title: GeoAgent: Evaluating VLM Geolocalization Through Embodied Navigation
authors: Arka Mukherjee, Soham Roy, Kartikeya Trivedi, Shreya Ghosh
abstract: Modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform well above the human baseline in image geolocalization, a task critically important in disaster response, OSINT verification, and location privacy. However, most efforts to study AI behavior on the task remain limited to static image-based retrieval, classification, and predictions. We argue that faithful recreation of the task should involve embodied navigation, where a multimodal agent autonomously explores its surroundings to gather observations before submitting a prediction. To this end, we introduce \textbf{GeoAgent}, an agentic environment-based benchmark that requires agents to navigate Street View environments to refine their geolocalization through sequential reasoning. Our analysis shows that modern VLMs struggle to discern regional patterns while succeeding at country- and continent-level predictions. When compared to static image-based baselines, agentic navigation significantly improves accuracy across established metrics. We also note severe bias in a developed/developing region context across frontier model architectures and poor self-improvement capabilities given incorrect priors. Overall, our work establishes the challenges of embodied navigation and geospatial reasoning. We publicly release our code and the GeoAgent environment: https://geoagent-benchmark.github.io

title: SpatialTrust: A Benchmark for Environmental Risk Recognition in Secure Authentication
authors: Junbin Lu, Hsiang-Wei Huang, Saesha Wadhwa, Yu Ting Hsu, Jenq-Neng Hwang
abstract: Visual environmental risk recognition plays an important role in secure authentication, where a user's surroundings may reveal sensitive information or introduce potential security risks. However, existing evaluations of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) rarely examine whether models can reliably recognize, localize, and explain such risks in spatially grounded authentication scenarios. We present SpatialTrust, a question-answering benchmark for evaluating environmental risk recognition in secure authentication. SpatialTrust assesses five complementary abilities: sensitive factor detection, direct factor identification, indirect factor identification, direct factor explanation, and indirect factor explanation. We evaluate both proprietary and open-source MLLMs and find that current models show limited performance, especially in understanding and explaining indirect risks, indicating that spatial risk awareness remains a challenging capability for MLLMs. In addition, we introduce SpatialTrustGuard, a structured QA-and-audit pipeline that improves Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct from 36.78% to 41.12% overall. Our findings highlight the need for dedicated benchmarks and structured inference methods to improve the trustworthiness of MLLMs in secure authentication.

title: Blind Dexterity: Whole-Body Humanoid Manipulation via Pure Proprioception
authors: Aditya Bhatt, Oleg Kaidanov, Puze Liu, Jan Peters
abstract:
We present blind, whole-body manipulation skills on a Unitree G1 humanoid using only onboard proprioception, without cameras, markers, force-torque, or tactile sensors. Despite this minimal sensing, the trained policies exhibit surprising capability across qualitatively different tasks: push-resilient bipedal walking without IMU feedback, active soccer ball trapping with a foot, seeking and lifting a suitcase by its handle, and mounting a randomly positioned skateboard.
  We argue that these capabilities arise from a key underappreciated signal: the way the joint encoder readouts evolve under purposeful compliant contact, effectively forming a whole-body tactile channel. By generating contact-rich motions, the trained policies actively probe the environment; as a result, task-relevant object state (e.g., pose) becomes increasingly decodable from short proprioceptive histories. We expose this information using compact task-specific state estimators trained alongside, but fully separately from, the policies; their prediction errors decrease rapidly after informative contact.
  Our results indicate that joint encoder-based proprioception, combined with compliant actuation (now widely available on commercial robots and low-cost motors) is already a strong, practical substrate for whole-body dexterous manipulation and interactive perception, and therefore a natural foundation on which richer sensing can be layered.
zh_title: 盲人灵巧：纯本体感受实现全身人形机器人操作
translation:
我们展示了在Unitree G1人形机器人上仅使用板载本体感受的盲式全身操作技能，无需摄像头、标记、力矩或触觉传感器。尽管传感极少，训练出的策略在性质不同的任务中表现出惊人的能力：包括无IMU反馈的抗推双足行走、用脚主动接住足球、寻找并提起手提箱以及安装随机放置的滑板。
我们认为这些能力源于一个被低估的关键信号：关节编码器读数在有目的的柔顺接触下演变的方式，有效地形成了一个全身触觉通道。通过生成接触丰富的运动，训练出的策略主动探测环境；因此，任务相关的物体状态（例如姿态）变得越来越容易从短暂的本体感受历史中解码。我们通过与策略同时但完全独立训练的紧凑任务特定状态估计器来揭示这些信息；在信息接触后，它们的预测误差迅速减小。
我们的结果表明，基于关节编码器的本体感受，结合柔顺驱动（目前在商用机器人和低成本电机上广泛可用），已经成为全身灵巧操作和交互感知一个强大、实用的基础，因此也是在此基础上叠加更丰富感知的一个自然基础。
tldr: 人形机器人仅通过本体感受，无需其他传感器，即可实现全身灵巧操作，通过关节编码器形成全身触觉通道。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于证明了在极简传感条件下，通过利用关节编码器读数作为一种“全身触觉”通道，人形机器人也能实现高度灵巧的全身操作。它挑战了传统上对外部传感器（如视觉、力矩传感器）的依赖，为低成本和鲁棒的机器人系统设计提供了新的视角。其局限性可能在于对环境的先验知识要求以及任务特定状态估计器的泛化能力。
motivation: 探索在最小传感条件下，人形机器人实现复杂操作的能力，并利用被低估的关节编码器信号作为全身触觉通道。
method: 使用Unitree G1人形机器人，仅依靠本体感受（关节编码器读数），不使用摄像头、标记、力矩或触觉传感器。通过生成接触丰富的运动，策略主动探测环境。训练策略时，同时但独立地训练紧凑的任务特定状态估计器，以从本体感受历史中解码物体状态。
results: 实现了在不同任务中的惊人能力，包括无IMU反馈的抗推双足行走、用脚主动接足球、寻找并提起手提箱以及安装随机放置的滑板。预测误差在信息接触后迅速减小。
conclusion: 关节编码器本体感受与柔顺驱动相结合，是全身灵巧操作和交互感知一个强大、实用的基础，未来可在此基础上叠加更丰富的感知。

title: CoCoA: Context-Conditional Cultural Alignment for Large Language Models
authors: Kyungdon Lee, Wei Xu, Alan Ritter, Dong-Ho Lee, JinYeong Bak
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often favor Western-associated entities across cultural contexts. Conventional debiasing methods aim for uniform neutrality, but cultural bias mitigation demands context-conditional behavior, preferring culturally appropriate entities when cultural cues are present and remaining neutral when they are absent. We propose CoCoA (Context-Conditional Cultural Alignment), a framework that learns this behavior through dual-context training on the same entity pairs under contexts with and without cultural cues. CoCoA combines a contrastive alignment objective with calibration and drift regularization, optimized through goal-aware gradient reconciliation. We evaluate CoCoA on CAMeL and Camellia, two entity-centric cultural bias benchmarks, across ten language settings and four LLMs. CoCoA reduces the Cultural Bias Score from 43 to 24 on average while maintaining near-neutral preferences at 50.2, with minimal impact on general performance across five standard benchmarks. These findings highlight that effective cultural alignment requires context-conditional modeling rather than uniform debiasing, and establish a new direction for mitigating entity-centric cultural bias in LLMs.
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 22 pages, 4 figures, 19 tables
zh_title: CoCoA：大型语言模型的上下文条件文化对齐
translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）在不同文化背景下经常偏向与西方相关的实体。传统的去偏方法旨在实现统一的中立性，但文化偏见的缓解需要上下文条件行为，即在存在文化线索时偏向文化适宜的实体，而在不存在文化线索时保持中立。我们提出了CoCoA（上下文条件文化对齐），一个通过对具有和不具有文化线索的上下文中的相同实体对进行双上下文训练来学习这种行为的框架。CoCoA将对比对齐目标与校准和漂移正则化相结合，并通过目标感知梯度协调进行优化。我们在CAMeL和Camellia这两个以实体为中心的文化偏见基准上，跨十种语言设置和四种LLM评估了CoCoA。CoCoA平均将文化偏见分数从43降低到24，同时将接近中立的偏好保持在50.2，对五个标准基准的整体性能影响最小。这些发现强调，有效的文化对齐需要上下文条件建模而非统一去偏，并为缓解LLM中以实体为中心的文化偏见开辟了新方向。
tldr: CoCoA是一个用于大型语言模型的框架，通过上下文条件训练来减少文化偏见，使其在有文化线索时偏向文化适宜的实体，在没有时保持中立，显著降低了文化偏见分数。
ai_comments: CoCoA的创新之处在于其“上下文条件”的文化对齐方法，这与传统追求“统一中立”的去偏方法形成对比。它认识到文化偏见的缓解不应是简单地移除所有偏见，而是在特定文化语境下展现适当的文化偏好，而在通用语境下保持中立。这种细致入微的方法对于构建真正全球化和文化敏感的LLM至关重要。其双上下文训练和目标感知梯度协调是实现这一目标的具体技术手段。
motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在不同文化背景下经常偏向与西方相关的实体。传统的去偏方法旨在实现统一的中立性，但文化偏见的缓解需要上下文条件行为，即在存在文化线索时偏向文化适宜的实体，而在不存在文化线索时保持中立。
method: 本文提出了CoCoA（上下文条件文化对齐）框架。CoCoA通过对具有和不具有文化线索的上下文中的相同实体对进行双上下文训练来学习上下文条件行为。它结合了对比对齐目标与校准和漂移正则化，并通过目标感知梯度协调进行优化。
results: CoCoA在CAMeL和Camellia这两个以实体为中心的文化偏见基准上，跨十种语言设置和四种LLM进行了评估。CoCoA平均将文化偏见分数从43降低到24，同时将接近中立的偏好保持在50.2，并且对五个标准基准的整体性能影响最小。
conclusion: 有效的文化对齐需要上下文条件建模而非统一去偏。这项研究为缓解LLM中以实体为中心的文化偏见开辟了新方向。

title: Generalizable Multi-Agent Planning from Signal Temporal Logic Specifications via Diffusion
authors: Joe Eappen, Zikang Xiong, Shreyash S. Iyengar, Suresh Jagannathan
abstract: Multi-agent systems in the real-world (e.g., drone swarms, autonomous cars, warehouse robots) must satisfy rich, temporal tasks while avoiding collisions. Signal Temporal Logic (STL) elegantly encodes such objectives, but current STL planning methods face critical limitations. State-of-the-art optimization-based approaches can handle arbitrary STL specifications but struggle with scalability, becoming computationally impractical as the number of agents grows. Learning-based methods efficiently handle a large number of agents with rapid planning times but fare poorly when deployment-time objectives differ from those used during training, and do not support planning tasks that require different specifications to be ascribed to different agents (i.e., heterogeneity) or team-level specifications requiring coordination of multiple agents. This fundamental trade-off between generalizability and scalability presents a challenge for realizing multi-agent STL planning algorithms in practice. To overcome this challenge, we introduce a new diffusion method for multi-agent planning with STL specifications. Using a differentiable approximation of STL, we integrate the STL gradient in the denoising process, making our approach generalizable to novel formulas whose predicates are placed anywhere within the goal region covered during training, while achieving the same scalability as existing learning-based methods. Our method supports heterogeneous specifications, and by using diffusion models, naturally enhances plan diversity, thereby significantly reducing safety-related violations (e.g., collisions) among agents. A detailed evaluation study justifies the utility of STL-guided diffusion-based multi-agent planners for constructing generalizable, scalable, and diverse plans. Videos and code are available at https://www.jeappen.com/diff-ma-stl/ and https://github.com/jeappen/diff-ma-stl .
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L), 2026
zh_title: 基于扩散的信号时序逻辑规范的可泛化多智能体规划
translation: 现实世界中的多智能体系统（例如无人机群、自动驾驶汽车、仓库机器人）必须在避免碰撞的同时满足丰富的时序任务。信号时序逻辑（STL）能够优雅地编码此类目标，但当前的STL规划方法面临关键限制。最先进的基于优化的方法可以处理任意STL规范，但在可扩展性方面存在困难，随着智能体数量的增加，计算变得不切实际。基于学习的方法可以高效处理大量智能体并实现快速规划时间，但在部署时目标与训练时目标不同时表现不佳，并且不支持需要为不同智能体分配不同规范（即异构性）或需要多个智能体协调的团队级规范的规划任务。这种泛化性与可扩展性之间的根本权衡为在实践中实现多智能体STL规划算法带来了挑战。为了克服这一挑战，我们引入了一种新的基于扩散的多智能体STL规范规划方法。通过STL的可微分近似，我们将STL梯度集成到去噪过程中，使我们的方法能够泛化到其谓词位于训练期间覆盖的目标区域内任意位置的新颖公式，同时实现与现有基于学习的方法相同的可扩展性。我们的方法支持异构规范，并且通过使用扩散模型，自然地增强了规划多样性，从而显著减少了智能体之间的安全相关违规（例如碰撞）。详细的评估研究证明了STL引导的基于扩散的多智能体规划器在构建可泛化、可扩展和多样化计划方面的实用性。视频和代码可在 https://www.jeappen.com/diff-ma-stl/ 和 https://github.com/jeappen/diff-ma-stl 获取。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于扩散的新方法，用于多智能体系统在信号时序逻辑（STL）规范下的规划，解决了现有方法在可扩展性和泛化性之间的权衡问题，并提高了规划的多样性和安全性。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将信号时序逻辑（STL）的梯度与扩散模型相结合，巧妙地解决了传统优化方法在可扩展性上的局限性以及学习方法在泛化性上的不足。这种结合不仅实现了对大规模和异构多智能体任务的高效规划，而且通过扩散模型的特性自然地增强了规划的多样性，从而显著提升了系统的安全性和鲁棒性。该方法为实际多智能体系统的部署，尤其是在复杂时序任务和安全要求高的场景中，提供了重要的理论和实践价值。
motivation: 现有STL多智能体规划方法在可扩展性（优化方法）和泛化性（学习方法）之间存在根本性权衡，无法有效处理大规模智能体、异构规范或团队级协调任务，同时难以保证规划的多样性和安全性。
method: 本文引入了一种新的基于扩散的多智能体规划方法，利用STL的可微分近似，将STL梯度集成到去噪过程中，从而实现对STL规范的多智能体规划。
results: 该方法对新颖公式具有泛化能力，达到与现有学习方法相同的可扩展性，支持异构规范，并通过扩散模型自然地增强了规划多样性，显著减少了智能体之间的安全相关违规（例如碰撞）。
conclusion: STL引导的基于扩散的多智能体规划器在构建可泛化、可扩展和多样化计划方面具有实用性，能有效解决多智能体STL规划中的挑战，为实际应用提供了有力的解决方案。

title: Learning Human Health and Diseases from 24-hour Wrist Movement
authors: Yong Wang, Dylan McGagh, Katya Broomberg, Zizheng Zhang, Jonathan Carter, Junayed Naushad, Laura Brocklebank, Yang Sun, George Nicholson, Dianjianyi Sun, Canqing Yu, Jun Lv, Maxim Barnard, Hubert Lam, Andrew Steptoe, David W. Eyre, Liming Li, Zhengming Chen, Naomi Wray, Spiros Denaxas, Gary S. Collins, Huaidong Du, Aiden Doherty, Hang Yuan
abstract: Much of human health and function unfolds beyond the clinic, through the movements of everyday life. Wrist-worn accelerometers capture these movements continuously, yet their rich signals are often reduced to a small set of predefined behavioural summary measures. Here, we present Sensori, a self-supervised foundation model that learns general-purpose health representations directly from 24 hours of raw tri-axial wrist movement. We developed and evaluated the model across four population-based cohorts from the United Kingdom, China and the United States, comprising 122,640 participants contributing 683,617 person-days of free-living recordings. Sensori condensed each day of movement into a representation that captured diverse movement behaviours, demographic characteristics, health axes and physical function. Evaluation in independent cohorts showed that these representations generalised across populations and measurement settings without retraining. When added to common clinical covariates, Sensori significantly improved prevalent disease classification for 52 of 102 eligible conditions (median delta AUROC, 0.060; range, 0.012-0.242) and incident disease risk prediction for 26 of 87 eligible conditions (median delta Uno's C-index, 0.064; range, 0.025-0.172), with the largest gains for neurological and psychiatric disorders. These findings establish 24-hour wrist movement as a rich and scalable source of health information, with the potential to support passive health monitoring and disease prediction at population scale.
zh_title: 从24小时手腕运动中学习人类健康与疾病
translation: 人类健康和功能很大一部分在临床之外，通过日常生活的运动展现。腕戴式加速度计持续捕捉这些运动，但其丰富的信号通常被简化为一小组预定义的行为摘要测量。在此，我们提出了Sensori，一个自监督基础模型，直接从24小时原始三轴手腕运动中学习通用健康表征。我们在来自英国、中国和美国的四个基于人群的队列中开发和评估了该模型，包括122,640名参与者，贡献了683,617人日的自由生活记录。Sensori将每日运动浓缩为能够捕捉各种运动行为、人口统计学特征、健康轴和身体功能的表征。在独立队列中的评估表明，这些表征无需再训练即可推广到不同人群和测量设置。当添加到常见临床协变量时，Sensori显著改善了102种合格疾病中52种的流行病分类（AUROC中位数增量0.060；范围，0.012-0.242），以及87种合格疾病中26种的发病风险预测（Uno's C指数中位数增量0.064；范围，0.025-0.172），其中神经和精神疾病的增益最大。这些发现确立了24小时手腕运动作为丰富且可扩展的健康信息来源，具有支持人口规模被动健康监测和疾病预测的潜力。
tldr: Sensori是一个自监督基础模型，能从24小时手腕运动数据中学习通用健康表征，显著提高了多种疾病的分类和风险预测，证明了手腕运动作为健康信息来源的潜力。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一个自监督基础模型Sensori，能够从原始、连续的腕部运动数据中自动学习全面的健康表征，而非依赖预定义的行为指标。其重要性体现在模型在大规模人群中的泛化能力，以及在多种疾病分类和风险预测方面带来的显著性能提升，特别是对于难以通过传统方式检测的神经和精神疾病。这为利用可穿戴设备进行大规模、被动式健康监测和早期疾病预警开辟了新途径。
motivation: 人类健康和功能很大一部分体现在日常生活中，通过手腕佩戴的加速度计可以持续捕捉这些运动，但其丰富信号常被简化为预定义的行为摘要测量。因此，需要一种方法来更有效地利用这些原始、连续的运动数据。
method: 本研究提出了Sensori，一个自监督基础模型，直接从24小时原始三轴手腕运动中学习通用健康表征。该模型在来自英国、中国和美国的四个基于人群的队列中开发和评估，涉及122,640名参与者，贡献了683,617人日的自由生活记录。
results: Sensori将每日运动浓缩为能够捕捉各种运动行为、人口统计学特征、健康轴和身体功能的表征。这些表征在独立队列中无需再训练即可推广到不同人群和测量设置。将Sensori添加到常见临床协变量后，显著改善了102种合格疾病中52种的流行病分类（AUROC中位数增量0.060），以及87种合格疾病中26种的发病风险预测（Uno's C指数中位数增量0.064），其中神经和精神疾病的增益最大。
conclusion: 这些发现确立了24小时手腕运动作为丰富且可扩展的健康信息来源，具有支持人口规模被动健康监测和疾病预测的潜力。

title: Fair Division Under Boolean Valuations: Beyond Normalization
authors: Nisarg Shah, Paritosh Verma
abstract:
We study fair division of indivisible items when agents have arbitrary two-level preferences: the value of each agent for any set of items is Boolean, which need not be monotone or additive. Notably, we do not impose the standard assumption of normalization, i.e., different agents may value the empty set at different Boolean levels. Since the preferences are nonmonotone, envy-freeness up to one item (EF1) and envy-freeness up to any item (EFX) each admit several variants, depending on which items are tested for removal and whether they are removed from the envious agent's bundle or the envied agent's bundle. This paper investigates the existence of these variants of EF1 and EFX, on their own and together with economic efficiency, incentive compatibility, feasibility constraints, and lottery-based randomization. Our results highlight that the existence landscape depends crucially on the number of normalized agents, who value the empty bundle at the lower Boolean level.
  The authors used significant assistance from GPT-5.6-Sol for deriving theoretical results, verified any AI-generated proofs for correctness, and expanded on the exposition and simplified arguments, with the aid of GPT-5.6-Sol and Claude Opus 5.
zh_title: 布尔估值下的公平分配：超越规范化
translation:
我们研究当代理具有任意两级偏好时不可分物品的公平分配：每个代理对任何物品集的估值都是布尔值，其不一定是单调或可加的。值得注意的是，我们不施加规范化的标准假设，即不同的代理可能对空集有不同的布尔估值。由于偏好是非单调的，所以“除去一件物品的无嫉妒”（EF1）和“除去任意一件物品的无嫉妒”（EFX）都存在几种变体，这取决于测试移除哪些物品以及它们是从嫉妒代理的捆绑包中移除还是从被嫉妒代理的捆绑包中移除。本文探讨了这些EF1和EFX变体的存在性，无论是单独考虑还是与经济效率、激励兼容性、可行性约束以及基于彩票的随机化结合考虑。我们的结果强调，存在性景观关键取决于规范化代理的数量，即那些对空捆绑包估值为较低布尔水平的代理。
作者在推导理论结果时获得了GPT-5.6-Sol的显著帮助，验证了任何AI生成的证明的正确性，并在GPT-5.6-Sol和Claude Opus 5的帮助下扩展了论述并简化了论证。
tldr: 本文研究在布尔估值下、不假设规范化的不可分物品的公平分配问题，探索EF1和EFX变体的存在性，并发现其存在性景观取决于规范化代理的数量。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于放宽了公平分配研究中常见的规范化假设，即允许代理对空集有不同的估值，这使得模型更具普遍性。此外，明确指出使用了AI工具（GPT-5.6-Sol和Claude Opus 5）辅助理论结果推导和论证简化，并强调了人工验证AI生成证明的正确性，体现了研究方法的透明度和对AI辅助工具的审慎使用。
motivation: 现有研究通常假设规范化（即代理对空集的估值相同），但本文旨在研究在更一般的布尔估值下，不施加规范化假设时，不可分物品的公平分配问题。
method: 研究了在布尔估值下，EF1和EFX的各种变体的存在性，并结合经济效率、激励兼容性、可行性约束以及基于彩票的随机化进行分析。
results: 结果表明，这些公平性变体的存在性景观关键取决于规范化代理（即对空捆绑包估值为较低布尔水平的代理）的数量。
conclusion: 在布尔估值下，不进行规范化假设时，公平分配（EF1和EFX）变体的存在性与对空集估值较低的代理数量密切相关。

title: Target-Aware State-Adaptive $p$-Dirichlet Graph Neural Regression for Non-Invasive Body-Composition Estimation
authors: Nadejda Drenska, Matthew Lemoine, Gowri Priya Sunkara, Yu Wang, Sri Lakshmi Sravani Devarakonda, Steven B. Heymsfield
abstract: Accurate estimation of body-composition outcomes, including body fat percentage (BFP), bone mineral density (BMD), and appendicular lean mass (ALM), is important for evaluating metabolic, skeletal, and muscular health. Direct assessment using dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA), however, requires specialized equipment and involves ionizing radiation. We propose a target-aware, state-adaptive $p$-Dirichlet energy-flow graph neural regression ($p$SADE-GNR) framework for estimating these outcomes from non-invasive anthropometric measurements. A neural encoder maps participant representations to hidden states that are propagated over an outcome-specific participant-similarity graph by a state-adaptive forward-Euler discretization of the graph $p$-Dirichlet energy flow. Graph distances weight each original or latent coordinate by its normalized absolute training-fold correlation with the outcome. Using clinical data from the Pennington Biomedical Research Center and five-fold cross-validation, the correlation-weighted model using the original standardized measurements achieved the lowest root mean squared error in all nine primary outcome-cohort combinations and outperformed previously reported support vector regression or least-squares support vector regression reference values in eight of nine comparisons. Autoencoder, variational-autoencoder, and Gaussian-mixture variational-autoencoder representations generally did not improve primary-outcome prediction or reduce computational cost. In an exploratory age-prediction analysis including ALM, BMD, and BFP as predictors, the correlation-weighted GMVAE model achieved the lowest mean error in all three cohorts. These results support target-aware, state-adaptive $p$-Dirichlet graph neural regression for non-invasive body-composition estimation.

zh_title: 目标感知状态自适应 $p$-狄利克雷图神经网络回归用于无创人体成分估计
translation: 准确估计人体成分结果，包括体脂百分比（BFP）、骨矿物质密度（BMD）和四肢瘦体重（ALM），对于评估代谢、骨骼和肌肉健康至关重要。然而，使用双能X射线吸收法（DXA）进行直接评估需要专业设备并涉及电离辐射。我们提出了一种目标感知、状态自适应 $p$-狄利克雷能量流图神经网络回归（$p$SADE-GNR）框架，用于从无创人体测量数据中估计这些结果。一个神经编码器将参与者表示映射到隐藏状态，这些状态通过图 $p$-狄利克雷能量流的状态自适应前向欧拉离散化，在特定于结果的参与者相似性图上传播。图距离通过其与结果的归一化绝对训练折叠相关性来加权每个原始或潜在坐标。使用来自彭宁顿生物医学研究中心的临床数据和五折交叉验证，使用原始标准化测量值的相关性加权模型在所有九种主要结果-队列组合中实现了最低的均方根误差，并在九次比较中的八次中优于先前报道的支持向量回归或最小二乘支持向量回归参考值。自动编码器、变分自动编码器和高斯混合变分自动编码器表示通常不能改善主要结果预测或降低计算成本。在包含ALM、BMD和BFP作为预测变量的探索性年龄预测分析中，相关性加权GMVAE模型在所有三个队列中均实现了最低的平均误差。这些结果支持目标感知、状态自适应 $p$-狄利克雷图神经网络回归用于无创人体成分估计。

title: ENPINN: Energy-Norm-Guided Gradient-Enhanced PINNs for Generalized Transport Problems with Sharp Gradients
authors: Subhendu Maity, Pratibhamoy Das, Arihant Patawari, Ameya D. Jagtap
abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have emerged as a meshless alternative to conventional numerical methods for solving partial differential equations (PDEs). However, their limited ability to capture sharp gradients can lead to substantial errors when resolving boundary and interior layers. Here, we introduce an energy-norm-enhanced PINN (ENPINN) that incorporates gradient information and variational structure into the loss function to improve the resolution of layer-dominated solutions. We first examine two related formulations: weak-loss PINNs (WLPINNs), which incorporate test functions into the conventional PINN residual, and gradient-enhanced PINNs (gPINNs), which augment the loss with spatial derivatives of the PDE residual. By analyzing these formulations, we identify their limitations in resolving steep solution gradients and motivate the systematic construction of ENPINN. We establish theoretically how the energy-norm error depends on the ENPINN loss and show that a suitably modified residual-derivative term is essential for accurately capturing boundary layers. We further establish the existence of neural-network approximations with arbitrarily small energy error and derive corresponding derivative bounds, providing a theoretical foundation for the proposed framework. The performance of ENPINN is assessed through systematic comparisons with existing PINN variants for convection-diffusion-reaction problems exhibiting steep gradients. Numerical experiments include a combustion model, a coupled multi-scale system, a two-dimensional Burgers equation with an interior layer, and a three-dimensional time-dependent problem.
zh_title: ENPINN：求解具尖锐梯度的广义输运问题的能量范数导引梯度增强PINN
translation: 物理信息神经网络（PINN）已成为求解偏微分方程（PDEs）的一种无网格替代传统数值方法。然而，它们捕捉尖锐梯度的能力有限，在解析边界层和内部层时会导致巨大误差。在此，我们引入了一种能量范数增强的PINN（ENPINN），它将梯度信息和变分结构并入损失函数中，以改进对层支配型解的分辨率。我们首先检验了两种相关形式：弱损失PINNs（WLPINNs），将测试函数引入传统PINN残差中；以及梯度增强PINNs（gPINNs），用PDE残差的空间导数扩充损失。通过分析这些形式，我们识别出它们在解析陡峭解梯度方面的局限性，并推动了ENPINN的系统构建。我们在理论上确立了能量范数误差如何取决于ENPINN损失，并表明适当修改的残差导数项对于准确捕捉边界层至关重要。我们进一步确立了具有任意小能量误差的神经网络逼近的存在性，并导出了相应的导数界，为所提出的框架提供了理论基础。通过与现有的PINN变体对表现出陡峭梯度的对流-扩散-反应问题的系统比较，评估了ENPINN的性能。数值实验包括燃烧模型、耦合多尺度系统、具有内部层的二维Burgers方程以及三维时间相关问题。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为ENPINN的新型物理信息神经网络，通过引入能量范数和梯度信息，显著提升了求解具有尖锐梯度和边界层问题的精度。
ai_comments: 本文针对PINN在处理具有尖锐梯度（如边界层和内部层）的偏微分方程时存在的精度不足问题，创新性地提出了ENPINN框架。该方法通过结合能量范数、梯度信息和变分结构构建损失函数，不仅在理论上给出了严格的误差界和逼近定理，还在燃烧模型、多尺度系统和高维Burgers方程等复杂数值实验中验证了其优越性。这对推进物理信息神经网络在复杂多尺度流动和输运问题中的应用具有重要价值。
motivation: 传统的物理信息神经网络（PINN）在捕捉尖锐梯度（如边界层和内部层）方面能力有限，导致在求解相关偏微分方程时会产生显著误差，因此需要开发能有效提高层支配型解分辨率的新方法。
method: 提出能量范数增强的PINN（ENPINN）框架，通过在损失函数中整合梯度信息和变分结构，并系统分析弱损失PINN（WLPINNs）和梯度增强PINN（gPINNs）的局限性，设计了修正的残差导数项以准确捕捉边界层，同时建立了理论误差界与逼近定理。
results: 通过对具陡峭梯度的对流-扩散-反应问题（包括燃烧模型、耦合多尺度系统、二维Burgers方程及三维时间依赖问题）进行系统比较，数值实验证明ENPINN在解析尖锐梯度方面明显优于现有的PINN变体。
conclusion: ENPINN通过在损失函数中引入能量范数导引和梯度增强，成功克服了传统PINN在捕捉尖锐梯度时的局限性，为求解具边界层和内部层的广义输运问题提供了一种理论坚实且高效的无网格数值方法。

title: Adversarial Online Classification with a Preview
authors: Roi Livni, Sahil Singla
abstract:
Worst-case online classification is governed by sequential complexity, such as Littlestone dimension, and can be impossible even for statistically simple classes, such as thresholds of VC dimension one. We study a preview model in which an oblivious adversary fixes an entire labeled sequence of length $T$, a uniformly random subset of size $pT$ is revealed before prediction begins, and the remaining $(1-p)T$ examples are then presented in their original adversarial order.
  Against the best full-sequence hypothesis evaluated on the unrevealed examples, we characterize the dependence on the preview rate $p$: for binary classes of VC dimension $d$, the optimal excess loss is $Θ(d/p+\sqrt{dT})$, up to the trivial cap at $T$; for multiclass classes we obtain the corresponding $\widetilde O(d_{\rm DS}/p+\sqrt{d_{\rm Nat}T})$ bound with no dependence on the number of labels. Thus a random preview can replace worst-case sequential complexity by classical statistical dimensions without randomizing the online order. To achieve the sharp binary bound, our ChainedPrediction algorithm uses an online analogue of chaining, implemented as a multiscale aggregation algorithm rather than only as an analytic argument.
zh_title: 具有预览机制的对抗性在线分类
translation:
最坏情况下的在线分类受制于序列复杂度（如 Littlestone 维度），即使对于统计上简单的类别（例如 VC 维度为 1 的阈值），也可能无法进行。我们研究了一个预览模型：在这个模型中，一个遗忘对抗者（oblivious adversary）固定一个长度为 $T$ 的完整标记序列，在预测开始前随机揭示一个大小为 $pT$ 的子集，其余 $(1-p)T$ 个样本则按其原始的对抗顺序呈现。
针对在未揭示样本上评估的最佳完整序列假设，我们刻画了其对预览率 $p$ 的依赖关系：对于 VC 维度为 $d$ 的二分类，最优的过量损失为 $\Theta(d/p+\sqrt{dT})$（在 $T$ 的平凡上限之内）；对于多分类，我们得到了相应的 $\widetilde O(d_{\rm DS}/p+\sqrt{d_{\rm Nat}T})$ 界限，且与标签数量无关。因此，随机预览可以在不随机化在线顺序的情况下，用经典的统计维度替代最坏情况下的序列复杂度。为了达到尖锐的二分类界限，我们的 ChainedPrediction 算法使用了一种在线版本的链式论证（chaining），将其实现为多尺度聚合算法，而不仅仅是一个分析论证。
tldr: 论文研究了带预览机制的对抗在线分类问题，证明了随机预览能将困难的序列复杂度转化为经典的统计维度，并给出了最优的过量损失界限。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地引入了预览模型（Preview Model），通过在对抗性在线分类中加入预先随机揭示部分样本的机制，成功将最坏情况下的序列复杂度（如Littlestone维度）转化为经典的统计维度（如VC维度或Natarajan维度），从而在不改变在线顺序随机性的情况下打破了传统在线学习的悲剧，具有很高的理论价值。
motivation: 最坏情况下的在线分类受制于序列复杂度（如Littlestone维度），即使对于统计上简单的类别（如VC维为1的阈值）也可能无法进行，因此需要探索如何利用预览机制将在线序列复杂度转化为经典的统计维度。
method: 提出了一种预览模型，其中遗忘对抗者固定一个标记序列，并在预测开始前随机揭示大小为 $pT$ 的子集，其余样本按原始对抗顺序呈现；针对二分类提出了基于在线链式论证的多尺度聚合算法（ChainedPrediction）以实现尖锐的界限。
results: 对于VC维为 $d$ 的二分类，最优过量损失为 $\Theta(d/p+\sqrt{dT})$；对于多分类，获得了 $\tilde{O}(d_{\rm DS}/p+\sqrt{d_{\rm Nat}T})$ 的界限，且与标签数量无关。
conclusion: 论文通过研究带预览的对抗在线分类模型，证明了随机预览能够有效缓解最坏情况复杂度，并给出了最优的过量损失界限。算法层面设计的多尺度聚合算法（ChainedPrediction）也为在线学习中的链式论证提供了新的计算实现。

title: RadioSight: Predictive mmWave XR Network Optimization from Dynamic Neural Radio Fields
authors: Lihao Zhang, Paul Kudyba, Zhenlin An, Haijian Sun
abstract: Next-generation extended reality (XR) networks rely on mmWave communication for multi-gigabit throughput, yet highly directional links are vulnerable to user mobility and blockages, causing frequent outages under reactive beam management. Emerging neural radio fields can predict radio propagation, but prior work remains limited to offline channel reconstruction. We introduce RadioSight, a real-time multi-modal radio field system for predictive mmWave optimization and proactive Multi-User MIMO beamforming. RadioSight combines backward beam-tracing with real-time semantic object synchronization to anticipate RF geometry changes without full model retraining. Implemented as an edge-executable pipeline for commercial 28 GHz arrays, RadioSight determines each scheduling window's beams during the preceding window without exhaustive beam sweeps. Experiments show that RadioSight reduces beam-search error by up to ~50%, improves median throughput by 2x, and enhances link stability.

zh_title: RadioSight：基于动态神经无线电场的预测性毫米波XR网络优化
translation: 下一代扩展现实（XR）网络依赖毫米波通信提供多千兆比特吞吐量，然而高度定向的链路容易受到用户移动性和阻塞的影响，导致在反应式波束管理下频繁中断。新兴的神经无线电场可以预测无线电传播，但之前的工作仍局限于离线信道重建。我们引入了RadioSight，一个实时多模态无线电场系统，用于预测性毫米波优化和主动多用户MIMO波束赋形。RadioSight结合了反向波束追踪和实时语义对象同步，以预测射频几何变化而无需完全模型再训练。作为商业28 GHz阵列的边缘可执行管道实现，RadioSight在当前调度窗口内确定下一个调度窗口的波束，无需详尽的波束扫描。实验表明，RadioSight将波束搜索误差降低了约50%，将中值吞吐量提高了2倍，并增强了链路稳定性。

motivation: 下一代扩展现实（XR）网络依赖毫米波通信提供多千兆比特吞吐量，但高方向性链路容易受到用户移动性和阻塞的影响，导致在反应式波束管理下频繁中断。现有的神经无线电场工作仅限于离线信道重建，无法进行实时预测。
method: RadioSight结合了反向波束追踪和实时语义对象同步，以预测射频几何变化而无需完全模型再训练。它作为一个边缘可执行的管道，用于商用28 GHz阵列，在当前调度窗口内确定下一个调度窗口的波束，无需详尽的波束扫描。
results: RadioSight将波束搜索误差降低了约50%，将中值吞吐量提高了2倍，并增强了链路稳定性。
conclusion: RadioSight通过实时多模态无线电场系统实现了预测性毫米波优化和主动多用户MIMO波束赋形，有效解决了传统毫米波XR网络中因移动性和阻塞导致的频繁中断问题，显著提高了网络性能和稳定性。

title: Denoising as Projection: Constrained Optimization with Gradient-Guided Diffusion
authors: Runyu Zhang, Jiawei Zhang, Gioele Zardini, Saurabh Amin, Asuman Ozdaglar
abstract: Diffusion models are increasingly used not only for sampling from learned data distributions, but also for generating samples that optimize task-specific objectives. A common approach is to guide the reverse diffusion process using gradients of an external objective. However, when the data distribution is supported on a structured feasible set, such as a manifold or a constraint set, gradient guidance can move samples away from the learned data geometry. In this paper, we study a simple projected-gradient-guided diffusion update based on the observation that the Stein denoising operator can act as an approximate projection onto the data geometry. The proposed update incorporates the objective gradient inside the denoising step, yielding an inference-time method that uses only a pretrained denoiser and gradient evaluations. We analyze this update as an inexact projected-gradient method for constrained optimization over learned feasible geometries. Our theory covers three settings: linear manifolds, compact convex feasible sets, and compact Riemannian submanifolds. In all these settings, we prove descent and finite-time convergence guarantees. Numerical experiments support the theoretical interpretation and illustrate how the proposed update balances objective descent with preservation of the learned geometry.
zh_title: 去噪即投影：基于梯度引导扩散的约束优化
translation: 扩散模型不仅越来越多地用于从学习到的数据分布中采样，还用于生成优化特定任务目标的样本。一种常见的方法是使用外部目标的梯度来引导反向扩散过程。然而，当数据分布位于结构化的可行集上时，例如流形或约束集，梯度引导可能会使样本偏离学习到的数据几何。在本文中，我们研究了一种简单的投影梯度引导扩散更新，该更新基于Stein去噪算子可以近似投影到数据几何上的观察。所提出的更新将目标梯度纳入去噪步骤，产生了一种仅使用预训练的去噪器和梯度评估的推理时方法。我们将此更新分析为一种用于在学习到的可行几何上进行约束优化的不精确投影梯度方法。我们的理论涵盖了三种情况：线性流形、紧凸可行集和紧黎曼子流形。在所有这些情况下，我们都证明了下降和有限时间收敛的保证。数值实验支持了理论解释，并说明了所提出的更新如何平衡目标下降与保持学习到的几何结构。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种新的投影梯度引导扩散更新方法，用于在保持数据几何结构的同时优化特定任务目标。该方法利用Stein去噪算子近似投影到数据几何上，并将目标梯度融入去噪步骤，从而在推理时仅需预训练的去噪器和梯度评估。理论分析和数值实验均证明了该方法在不同几何设置下的收敛性和有效性。
ai_comments: 该研究提出的“去噪即投影”方法为解决结构化数据上的约束优化问题提供了一种新颖且有效的途径。将去噪算子与投影梯度相结合，巧妙地解决了传统梯度引导方法可能带来的数据几何失真问题。理论分析的严谨性和数值实验的有效性支持了该方法的潜力。未来的工作可以进一步探索该方法在更复杂的数据结构和更广泛的应用场景中的表现。
motivation: 当数据分布位于结构化可行集（如流形或约束集）上时，传统的梯度引导扩散方法可能会使样本偏离学习到的数据几何。因此，需要一种能够同时优化任务目标并保持数据几何结构的方法。
method: 提出了一种基于Stein去噪算子近似投影到数据几何上的投影梯度引导扩散更新方法。该方法将目标梯度融入去噪步骤，实现了一种推理时的方法，仅需预训练的去噪器和梯度评估。理论上，该方法被分析为一种用于学习到的可行几何上的约束优化问题的近似投影梯度方法，并涵盖了线性流形、紧凸可行集和紧黎曼子流形三种情况。
results: 在理论上，证明了该方法在三种几何设置（线性流形、紧凸可行集和紧黎曼子流形）下均具有下降和有限时间收敛的保证。数值实验结果支持了理论解释，并表明该方法能够有效地平衡目标下降和学习到的几何结构的保持。
conclusion: 该研究提出了一种新颖的投影梯度引导扩散更新方法，该方法能够有效地在约束优化问题中平衡目标下降和数据几何结构的保持，并在理论和实验上都得到了验证。

title: Generalized Hamming Weights of AJ-Gorenstein One-Point Codes
authors: Eliseo Sarmiento-Rosales, José Alberto Guzmán-Vega, Juan Carlos Jiménez-Cervantes
abstract:
We study generalized Hamming weights along the one-point code flag of an AJ-Gorenstein curve. We organize these weights in a graded array, the zero diagram, whose entries are generalized coweights: the largest numbers of evaluation points on which subcodes of prescribed dimensions vanish simultaneously. Twisted and Wei duality show that each row of the zero diagram determines both the generalized Hamming weights of a lower block of short codes and the missing weights of a reflected upper block of long codes in the GHW diagram of the complete flag. Our main quantitative result is a uniform coverage theorem. For an AJ-Gorenstein curve of genus $g$ and evaluation length $n>2g$, the proportion of generalized-weight positions determined exactly throughout the complete flag satisfies $\operatorname{Cov}_{\mathrm{full}} \ge \frac{n(n-1)+4g}{n(n+2g-1)}>\frac12$.
  Thus more than half of all generalized-weight positions in the complete flag are determined uniformly. For the smallest Suzuki curve, the general and Castle-specific mechanisms together determine $2{,}280$ of the $2{,}912$ positions, giving an exact coverage of $78.30\%$.
zh_title: AJ-Gorenstein单点码的广义汉明重量
translation: 我们研究了AJ-Gorenstein曲线上单点码旗的广义汉明重量。我们将这些重量组织在一个分级数组中，即零图，其条目是广义共重量：在给定维度的子码同时消失的最大评估点数量。扭曲对偶和Wei对偶表明，零图的每一行都确定了完整旗的GHW图中短码的下块的广义汉明重量和长码的反射上块的缺失重量。我们的主要定量结果是一个统一覆盖定理。对于亏格为$g$且评估长度$n>2g$的AJ-Gorenstein曲线，完整旗中精确确定的广义重量位置的比例满足 $\operatorname{Cov}_{\mathrm{full}} \ge \frac{n(n-1)+4g}{n(n+2g-1)}>\frac12$。因此，完整旗中超过一半的所有广义重量位置都是统一确定的。对于最小的Suzuki曲线，一般机制和Castle特定机制共同确定了2,912个位置中的2,280个，给出了78.30%的精确覆盖率。
tldr: 本文研究了AJ-Gorenstein曲线上单点码旗的广义汉明重量，通过构建零图和利用对偶性，提出了一个统一覆盖定理，表明超过一半的广义重量位置可以被确定，并在Suzuki曲线上验证了高覆盖率。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过引入零图和利用对偶性，为AJ-Gorenstein曲线的广义汉明重量提供了一种新的结构化和定量分析方法。其统一覆盖定理是一个重要的理论贡献，表明在特定条件下，广义汉明重量的大部分位置可以被确定，这对于纠错码的理论研究具有重要意义。在Suzuki曲线上的具体计算结果进一步验证了方法的有效性。
motivation: 研究AJ-Gorenstein曲线上单点码旗的广义汉明重量。
method: 通过构建一个分级数组——零图（其条目是广义共重量），并利用扭曲对偶和Wei对偶性来确定广义汉明重量。
results: 提出了一个统一覆盖定理：对于亏格为$g$且评估长度$n>2g$的AJ-Gorenstein曲线，完整旗中精确确定的广义重量位置的比例满足 $\operatorname{Cov}_{\mathrm{full}} \ge \frac{n(n-1)+4g}{n(n+2g-1)}>\frac12$。对于最小的Suzuki曲线，确定了2,912个位置中的2,280个，覆盖率为78.30%。
conclusion: 超过一半的完整旗中的所有广义重量位置是统一确定的。

title: ARMOR: Manifold-Oriented Training for Adversarially Robust Aerial Object Detection under Data Scarcity
authors: Haoran Wang, Matthew Lau, Alec Helbling, Matthew Hull, ShengYun Peng, Mansi Phute, Martin Andreoni, Willian T. Lunardi, Duen Horng Chau, Wenke Lee
abstract: Aerial object detection is increasingly deployed in real-world applications, but models remain vulnerable to physical, universal adversarial patches that cause them to miss objects. Furthermore, defenders face the practical constraint of training data scarcity: aerial imagery is costly to collect and label, so a deployment site typically yields hundreds of images rather than the tens of thousands that adversarial robustness benchmarks assume. To tackle model vulnerability and training data scarcity, we propose Adversarial Robustness with Manifold-Oriented Training (ARMOR), a novel defense that realizes the core insights of on-manifold adversarial training (OMAT) in low-data regimes. ARMOR builds on the insight of OMAT to model the data manifold - the compact structure capturing the data's relevant features - to learn and robustify these features during training. While OMAT relies on the data-intensive operations of training large generative models and adversarial training to achieve this, ARMOR adopts a data-efficient approach that reuses labels the detection task already supplies: ARMOR (i) masks image backgrounds to retain object-relevant features, and (ii) injects randomized patches on objects to improve feature robustness. Our low-data experiments with physically-realizable adversarial patches evaluate both query-free transfer attacks and defense-aware attacks. ARMOR maintains strong clean performance of over 0.90 model confidence, while improving adversarial robustness by up to 0.32 in model confidence over state-of-the-art defenses. Physical experiments with printed patches confirm that these gains survive deployment. Overall, ARMOR translates insights from manifold-based training to defend object detectors amidst training data scarcity.
zh_title: ARMOR：数据稀缺下对抗性鲁棒航空目标检测的流形导向训练
translation: 航空目标检测在现实世界应用中越来越多地部署，但模型仍然容易受到物理的、通用的对抗性补丁攻击，导致漏检。此外，防御者面临训练数据稀缺的实际限制：航空图像的收集和标注成本高昂，因此一个部署站点通常只能提供数百张图像，而不是对抗性鲁棒性基准所假设的数万张。为了解决模型脆弱性和训练数据稀缺问题，我们提出了对抗性鲁棒性与流形导向训练（ARMOR），这是一种新颖的防御方法，在低数据环境下实现了流形上对抗性训练（OMAT）的核心思想。ARMOR建立在OMAT的洞察力之上，通过建模数据流形——捕获数据相关特征的紧凑结构——来在训练过程中学习和增强这些特征的鲁棒性。虽然OMAT依赖于训练大型生成模型和对抗性训练的数据密集型操作来实现这一点，但ARMOR采用了一种数据高效的方法，重用检测任务已提供的标签：ARMOR（i）掩盖图像背景以保留与对象相关的特征，并且（ii）在对象上注入随机补丁以提高特征鲁棒性。我们的低数据实验使用可物理实现的对抗性补丁评估了无查询传输攻击和防御感知攻击。ARMOR保持了超过0.90的模型置信度的强大干净性能，同时在对抗性鲁棒性方面比最先进的防御方法提高了高达0.32的模型置信度。物理实验与打印补丁证实这些增益在部署中依然存在。总的来说，ARMOR将基于流形的训练见解转化为在训练数据稀缺的情况下防御目标检测器。
tldr: ARMOR提出了一种数据高效的方法，通过流形导向训练，在数据稀缺的情况下提高航空目标检测器对抗性攻击的鲁棒性。
ai_comments: ARMOR的创新之处在于它成功地将流形导向训练的强大概念应用于数据稀缺的实际场景中，这对于航空目标检测等数据收集成本高昂的领域具有重要意义。通过数据高效的策略（如背景掩码和随机补丁注入），它克服了传统OMAT对大量数据的依赖。该方法在实际物理攻击下的鲁棒性提升，证明了其在实际部署中的潜力。
motivation: 航空目标检测模型容易受到物理对抗性补丁的攻击，导致漏检，并且在实际部署中面临训练数据稀缺的挑战（通常只有数百张图像而非数万张）。
method: ARMOR（对抗性鲁棒性与流形导向训练）是一种新颖的防御方法，它在低数据环境下实现了流形上对抗性训练（OMAT）的核心思想。它通过建模数据流形来学习和增强相关特征，并采用数据高效的方法，重用检测任务已提供的标签：(i) 掩盖图像背景以保留与对象相关的特征，(ii) 在对象上注入随机补丁以提高特征鲁棒性。
results: ARMOR保持了超过0.90的模型置信度的强大干净性能，并在对抗性鲁棒性方面比最先进的防御方法提高了高达0.32的模型置信度。物理实验证实了这些增益在部署中依然有效。
conclusion: ARMOR将基于流形的训练思想应用于在训练数据稀缺的情况下防御目标检测器。

title: Linear Coding of LTI Sources Over Vector Gaussian Channels: A Majorization Approach
authors: Shihao Jin, Junhui Li, Shinji Hara, Wei Chen
abstract: We study the design of linear time-invariant (LTI) encoder-decoder pairs for transmitting the state of a discrete-time LTI vector source over power-constrained parallel Gaussian channels with feedback. Two types of power constraints are considered. Under individual subchannel power constraints, a necessary and sufficient condition for designing an encoder-decoder pair that achieves bounded estimation error covariance (EEC) is established via two coupled majorization inequalities involving the subchannel signal-to-noise ratios and the antistable poles of the source. Under total channel power constraint, we derive the minimum total power required for a feasible encoder-decoder design by exploiting partial-order progamming under majorization order. An analytical optimal power allocation is obtained for the case of equal noise variances, which admits a water-filling interpretation; for general noise case, a sequential water-filling algorithm is developed. Our results reveal that the difficulty of transmitting a discrete-time LTI source via LTI coding is governed not only by its topological entropy, but also by the evenness of the log-magnitudes of its antistable poles. The design methods for feasible encoder-decoder pairs are also provided.
zh_title: 线性时不变信源在矢量高斯信道上的线性编码：一种优超方法
translation: 我们研究了线性时不变（LTI）编码器-解码器对的设计，用于在有反馈的功率受限并行高斯信道上，传输离散时间LTI矢量信源的状态。考虑了两种类型的功率约束。在单独子信道功率约束下，通过涉及子信道信噪比和信源反稳定极点的两个耦合优超不等式，建立了设计实现有界估计误差协方差（EEC）的编码器-解码器对的充要条件。在总信道功率约束下，我们通过利用优超序下的偏序规划，推导了可行编码器-解码器设计所需的最小总功率。对于噪声方差相等的情况，获得了分析性的最优功率分配，这可以解释为注水法；对于一般噪声情况，开发了一种顺序注水算法。我们的结果表明，通过LTI编码传输离散时间LTI信源的难度不仅受其拓扑熵的影响，还受其反稳定极点对数幅值的均匀性的影响。还提供了可行编码器-解码器对的设计方法。
tldr: 本文研究了在有反馈的功率受限并行高斯信道上，传输离散时间LTI矢量信源状态的LTI编码器-解码器对的设计，并提出了在不同功率约束下的设计条件和最优功率分配策略。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过将优超理论应用于高斯信道上的LTI编码系统设计，做出了重要贡献。它不仅深入揭示了影响传输难度的关键因素，还提供了实用的设计方法和最优功率分配算法。其中，最优功率分配的“注水法”解释尤其值得关注，它为理解和实现高效通信提供了直观的视角。
motivation: 研究的动机是设计线性时不变（LTI）编码器-解码器对，用于在有反馈的功率受限并行高斯信道上，传输离散时间LTI矢量信源的状态。
method: 该研究通过以下方法进行：1. 在单独子信道功率约束下，利用涉及子信道信噪比和信源反稳定极点的两个耦合优超不等式，建立了实现有界估计误差协方差（EEC）的编码器-解码器对的充要条件。2. 在总信道功率约束下，利用优超序下的偏序规划，推导了可行编码器-解码器设计所需的最小总功率。3. 对于噪声方差相等的情况，获得了具有注水法解释的分析性最优功率分配；对于一般噪声情况，开发了一种顺序注水算法。
results: 研究结果如下：1. 在单独子信道功率约束下，建立了实现有界估计误差协方差（EEC）的LTI编码器-解码器对的充要条件。2. 在总信道功率约束下，推导了可行编码器-解码器设计所需的最小总功率。3. 获得了噪声方差相等情况下的分析性最优功率分配（具有注水法解释），并为一般噪声情况开发了顺序注水算法。4. 揭示了通过LTI编码传输离散时间LTI信源的难度不仅受其拓扑熵的影响，还受其反稳定极点对数幅值的均匀性的影响。5. 提供了可行编码器-解码器对的设计方法。
conclusion: 通过LTI编码传输离散时间LTI信源的难度由其拓扑熵和其反稳定极点对数幅值的均匀性共同决定。本研究提供了在不同功率约束下设计LTI编码器-解码器对的方法和最优功率分配策略。

title: A Sliding Window Filter on the Galilean Group for Consistent Aided Inertial Navigation with Unknown Measurement Delays
authors: Jonathan Kelly
abstract: We study aided inertial navigation when the aiding sensor measurements are subject to an unknown constant delay. The goal is to estimate the delay and navigation state jointly so that delayed measurements correct the trajectory at the appropriate times, yielding a more accurate navigation solution. We formulate the problem on the special Galilean group, which provides a natural state-space structure for aided navigation with uncertainty in both motion and timing. We then examine the observability of joint delay and state estimation and show that, for a single delayed measurement, the model admits an exact symmetry in which a change in the delay can be compensated by a change in the navigation state, leaving the measurement unchanged. Processing measurements individually allows spurious information to `leak' along the corresponding null direction of the measurement Jacobian, producing overconfident and inconsistent estimates. Applying measurements from multiple times together can eliminate this direction when the trajectory is informative enough. Motivated by this result, we develop a sliding window filter that retains a short history of navigation states and applies delayed aiding corrections jointly across the active window. We conduct a series of simulation studies to characterize estimator accuracy and consistency. The simulations demonstrate that an estimator that does not maintain an adequate window can rapidly become highly inconsistent, whereas even a short sliding window markedly improves consistency by providing the temporal support that observability requires.
comment: Accepted to the IEEE International Conference on Multisensor Fusion and Integration (MFI), Pilsen, Czechia, Sep 2-4, 2026
zh_title: 伽利略群上用于未知测量延迟辅助惯性导航的一致性滑动窗口滤波器
translation: 我们研究了当辅助传感器测量受到未知恒定延迟影响时的辅助惯性导航问题。目标是联合估计延迟和导航状态，以便延迟测量在适当的时间校正轨迹，从而产生更准确的导航解决方案。我们将问题建立在特殊伽利略群上，它为运动和时间不确定性下的辅助导航提供了自然的状态空间结构。然后，我们检查了联合延迟和状态估计的可观测性，并表明对于单个延迟测量，该模型存在一个精确的对称性，其中延迟的变化可以通过导航状态的变化来补偿，使测量结果保持不变。单独处理测量会导致虚假信息沿着测量雅可比的相应零方向“泄漏”，从而产生过度自信和不一致的估计。当轨迹信息足够丰富时，将来自多个时间的测量结果一起应用可以消除这个方向。受此结果的启发，我们开发了一种滑动窗口滤波器，该滤波器保留了导航状态的短期历史，并在活动窗口内联合应用延迟辅助校正。我们进行了一系列仿真研究来表征估计器的准确性和一致性。仿真表明，不保持足够窗口的估计器会迅速变得高度不一致，而即使是很短的滑动窗口也能通过提供可观测性所需的时间支持，显著提高一致性。
tldr: 该研究提出了一种在伽利略群上运行的滑动窗口滤波器，用于解决辅助惯性导航中未知测量延迟问题，通过联合估计延迟和导航状态，并结合多时间测量以提高估计的一致性和准确性。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于将未知测量延迟下的辅助惯性导航问题建模在伽利略群上，并提出了一种滑动窗口滤波器来解决由单个测量对称性引起的估计不一致问题。通过联合处理多时间测量，该方法有效地提高了估计的准确性和一致性，这对于实时导航系统具有重要意义。
motivation: 在辅助惯性导航中，当辅助传感器测量存在未知常数延迟时，目标是联合估计延迟和导航状态，以便延迟测量能在适当时间校正轨迹，从而获得更准确的导航解决方案。现有方法可能因测量雅可比的零方向导致过度自信和不一致的估计。
method: 该研究将问题建立在特殊伽利略群上，它为运动和时间不确定性下的辅助导航提供了自然的状态空间结构。通过分析联合延迟和状态估计的可观测性，发现单个延迟测量存在一个精确对称性。为解决此问题，开发了一种滑动窗口滤波器，该滤波器保留短期的导航状态历史，并在活动窗口内联合应用延迟辅助校正。
results: 仿真研究表明，不保持足够窗口的估计器会迅速变得高度不一致，而即使是很短的滑动窗口也能显著提高一致性，提供了可观测性所需的时间支持。
conclusion: 通过在伽利略群上使用滑动窗口滤波器，并在活动窗口内联合应用延迟辅助校正，可以有效解决辅助惯性导航中未知测量延迟导致的一致性问题，显著提高估计的一致性和准确性。

title: On the Plasticity Collapse in Continual Machine Unlearning
authors: Yingdan Shi, Xiang Xu, Kaize Ding, Alfred O. Hero, Ren Wang
abstract: Machine unlearning enables deep neural networks to selectively remove the influence of specific data in response to privacy and regulatory requirements. While prior work largely studies single-shot unlearning, real-world systems must accommodate continual unlearning, where multiple unlearning requests occur sequentially over time. In this work, we identify a fundamental limitation of this setting: plasticity collapse, a progressive breakdown in a model's ability to effectively forget. Through theoretical analysis of continual unlearning dynamics, we show that continual unlearning operations accumulate geometric constraints in parameter space, leading to saturated subspaces that restrict future updates. This structural effect induces two distinct failure modes: (1) Forward failure -- diminishing forgetting quality for subsequent tasks, and (2) Backward failure -- spontaneous re-memorization of previously forgotten information. Extensive experiments across multiple architectures, datasets, and methods in image classification confirm that plasticity collapse is not an artifact of specific implementations, but a pervasive phenomenon inherent to continual unlearning. Our findings reveal a critical barrier to the long-term reliability of machine unlearning systems and motivate the development of plasticity-preserving unlearning algorithms. Our code is available at https://github.com/TIML-Group/Continual-Machine-Unlearning-Plasticity-Collapse
zh_title: 关于持续机器遗忘中的可塑性崩溃
translation: 机器遗忘使深度神经网络能够根据隐私和监管要求选择性地删除特定数据的影响。虽然先前的工作主要研究单次遗忘，但现实世界系统必须适应持续遗忘，即多个遗忘请求按时间顺序发生。在这项工作中，我们识别了这种设置的一个根本性限制：可塑性崩溃，即模型有效遗忘能力的逐步丧失。通过对持续遗忘动力学的理论分析，我们表明持续遗忘操作在参数空间中积累了几何约束，导致饱和子空间限制了未来的更新。这种结构效应导致两种独特的故障模式：(1) 前向故障——后续任务的遗忘质量下降，以及 (2) 后向故障——先前遗忘信息的自发重新记忆。在图像分类中跨多个架构、数据集和方法的广泛实验证实，可塑性崩溃并非特定实现的产物，而是持续遗忘固有的普遍现象。我们的发现揭示了机器遗忘系统长期可靠性的一个关键障碍，并促使开发保留可塑性的遗忘算法。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/TIML-Group/Continual-Machine-Unlearning-Plasticity-Collapse 获取。
tldr: 本文识别并分析了持续机器遗忘中的一个根本性限制：可塑性崩溃，即模型有效遗忘能力的逐步丧失，导致后续遗忘质量下降和先前遗忘信息被重新记忆。
ai_comments: 本文识别并详细阐述了持续机器遗忘中的一个新颖且关键的挑战——“可塑性崩溃”，这对于理解和改进机器遗忘系统的长期可靠性具有重要意义。通过理论分析和全面的实验验证，该研究不仅揭示了问题，还明确指出了两种具体的失败模式。这一发现为未来的研究指明了方向，即需要开发能够保持模型可塑性的新型遗忘算法，以克服这一固有限制。
motivation: 机器学习遗忘使深度神经网络能够根据隐私和监管要求选择性地删除特定数据的影响。虽然现有工作主要研究单次遗忘，但现实世界系统必须适应持续遗忘，即多个遗忘请求按时间顺序发生。本文旨在识别并解决持续遗忘设置中的一个基本限制。
method: 本文通过对持续遗忘动力学的理论分析，展示了持续遗忘操作如何在参数空间中积累几何约束，导致饱和子空间限制未来的更新。此外，作者在多个架构、数据集和图像分类方法上进行了广泛的实验，以验证可塑性崩溃的普遍性。
results: 研究发现持续遗忘会导致可塑性崩溃，即模型有效遗忘能力的逐步丧失。这种结构效应导致两种独特的故障模式：(1) 前向故障——后续任务的遗忘质量下降；(2) 后向故障——先前遗忘信息的自发重新记忆。实验证实可塑性崩溃是一种普遍现象。
conclusion: 可塑性崩溃是机器遗忘系统长期可靠性的一个关键障碍，这促使需要开发保留可塑性的遗忘算法。

title: Task-Relevant Feature-Dynamics Fidelity Enables Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Transfer for Robotic Ultrasound Scanning
authors: Yizhao Qian, Jiayuan Luo, Wanyi Zhu, Yameng Zhang, Max Q.-H. Meng, Yixuan Yuan, Li Liu
abstract: Robotic ultrasound policies operating directly on B-mode images require extensive interaction data, whereas real-robot data collection is costly and safety-constrained. Simulation provides a scalable alternative, but zero-shot transfer depends not only on single-frame realism but also on whether simulated observations reproduce task-relevant feature changes induced by probe motion. We term this cross-domain consistency task-relevant feature-dynamics fidelity (TR-FDF). Under local regularity assumptions, our contraction analysis shows that greater sensitivity of TR-FDF mismatch to probe motion reduces the effective closed-loop contraction margin, whereas motion-independent errors primarily enlarge the residual error bound. Guided by this analysis, we develop a TR-FDF-oriented ultrasound simulator that combines a shared structural intermediate domain, trajectory-level fixed noise, and few-step conditional flow generation. In phantom experiments, a policy trained exclusively in simulation succeeded in 390 of 400 zero-shot deployments across four target planes. The simulator achieved an FID of 29.66 and generated observations at 67.1 Hz. Controlled interventions, ablations, and baseline comparisons showed that TR-FDF sensitivity complements single-frame realism in predicting zero-shot transfer performance.
zh_title: 任务相关特征动态保真度赋能机器人超声扫描的零样本仿真到真实迁移
translation: 机器人超声策略直接在B模式图像上操作需要大量交互数据，而真实机器人数据收集成本高且受安全限制。仿真是一个可扩展的替代方案，但零样本迁移不仅依赖于单帧真实性，还依赖于模拟观测是否能重现由探头运动引起的任务相关特征变化。我们将这种跨域一致性称为任务相关特征动态保真度（TR-FDF）。在局部正则性假设下，我们的收缩分析表明，TR-FDF失配对探头运动的敏感性越大，有效的闭环收缩裕度就越小，而与运动无关的误差主要会扩大残差误差界。受此分析的指导，我们开发了一种面向TR-FDF的超声仿真器，它结合了共享的结构中间域、轨迹级别的固定噪声和几步的条件流生成。在幻影实验中，一个仅在仿真中训练的策略在跨四个目标平面的400次零样本部署中成功了390次。该仿真器实现了29.66的FID，并以67.1 Hz的速度生成观测。受控干预、消融和基线比较表明，TR-FDF敏感性在预测零样本迁移性能方面补充了单帧真实性。
tldr: 机器人超声策略直接在B模式图像上操作需要大量交互数据，而真实机器人数据收集成本高且受安全限制。仿真是一个可扩展的替代方案，但零样本迁移不仅依赖于单帧真实性，还依赖于模拟观测是否能重现由探头运动引起的任务相关特征变化。我们将这种跨域一致性称为任务相关特征动态保真度（TR-FDF）。
ai_comments: 这项研究提出了一个有趣的新概念（TR-FDF），并开发了一个有效的仿真器来实现机器人超声扫描的零样本迁移。然而，研究中使用的局部正则性假设和收缩分析的适用性可能需要进一步的探讨。此外，虽然实验结果令人鼓舞，但仍需在更多样化的场景和机器人平台上进行验证。
motivation: 机器人超声策略需要大量交互数据，真实数据收集成本高且受安全限制，因此需要一种可扩展的仿真方法来实现零样本迁移。
method: 提出了一种面向TR-FDF的超声仿真器，结合了共享结构中间域、轨迹级固定噪声和几步条件流生成。
results: 在幻影实验中，一个仅在仿真中训练的策略在跨四个目标平面的400次零样本部署中成功了390次。仿真器实现了29.66的FID，并以67.1 Hz的速度生成观测。TR-FDF敏感性补充了单帧真实性在预测零样本迁移性能方面的作用。
conclusion: TR-FDF敏感性补充了单帧真实性在预测零样本迁移性能方面的作用，并且提出的仿真器在实际应用中表现良好。

title: LLM Judges as Raters: A Pre-Registered Audit of Severity, Halo, Reliability, and Version Instability in LLM Essay Scoring on Public Corpora
authors: Veerendra Kumar Sunkavalli
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as essay graders in learning analytics, evaluated almost exclusively with agreement statistics. Educational measurement warns that raters also differ in severity, show halo, and drift as instruments. We treat LLM judges as raters and run a pre-registered rater-effects battery (many-facet Rasch severity, residual halo, generalizability/decision studies, cross-version shifts, differential functioning) on public corpora in two languages (ENEM/Essay-BR; ASAP): 2,377 essays, 12 judges, 4 providers, 5 version contrasts, replicated cells, released as a score tensor. Judge severity spans 219 points on ENEM's 0-1000 scale; on ASAP the panel spread is 15-33% of the score range against a between-trained-human gap near 1%. Judge-human correlations sit in an undiscriminating .47-.56 band. All five version contrasts shift severity beyond a family-wise permutation null (up to 133 points), and one judge was deprecated mid-study, caught by identity canaries. Two pre-registered tests returned honest nulls: severity-adjusted leaderboard reversals did not survive a permutation null, and "silent drift" was refuted: agreement moved with severity in four of five contrasts. Replication yields self-consistency (phi>=.80 at k<=2) but not human-level accuracy, and a same-instrument check overturned our own halo comparison: matched on instrument and calibration, we find no credible evidence that judge halo exceeds the trained-human range.
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 8 tables. Under review at the Journal of Learning Analytics (LAK27 research track). Artifact: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/lak-27-A618
zh_title: 大语言模型评委作为评分员：对公共语料库中大语言模型论文评分的严苛性、光环效应、可靠性和版本不稳定性的预注册审计
translation: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作学习分析中的论文评分员，其评估几乎完全依赖于一致性统计。教育测量学警告说，评分员在严苛性方面也存在差异，表现出光环效应，并且作为工具会发生漂移。我们将LLM评委视为评分员，并在两种语言（ENEM/Essay-BR; ASAP）的公共语料库上运行了一项预注册的评分员效应评估（多面Rasch严苛性、残余光环效应、泛化性/决策研究、跨版本变化、差异性功能）：涉及2,377篇论文、12位评委、4家提供商、5个版本对比，并复制了单元格，作为评分张量发布。在ENEM的0-1000分量表上，评委严苛性跨越219点；在ASAP上，评委小组的传播范围是分数范围的15-33%，而训练有素的人类之间的差距接近1%。评委与人类的相关性处于0.47-0.56的无区分带。所有五个版本对比都使严苛性超出了家族式置换零假设（高达133点），一名评委在研究中途被身份金丝雀发现并弃用。两项预注册测试返回了诚实的零假设：经严苛性调整的排行榜逆转未通过置换零假设检验，“静默漂移”被驳斥：一致性在五个对比中的四个中随严苛性变化。复制产生了自我一致性（k<=2时phi>=0.80），但未达到人类水平的准确性，一项相同的工具检查推翻了我们自己的光环效应比较：在工具和校准匹配的情况下，我们没有可信证据表明评委的光环效应超过训练有素的人类范围。
tldr: 大语言模型（LLM）作为论文评分员时，存在显著的严苛性差异、版本不稳定性及中等可靠性，且不总能达到人类水平的准确性。
ai_comments: 这篇论文通过将教育测量学中用于人类评分员的严格原则应用于LLM论文评分，具有重要的意义。它揭示了严苛性变异和版本不稳定性等关键问题，这些问题在仅关注一致性统计时常被忽视。预注册的审计方法增强了研究结果的可信度。其局限性在于未能达到人类水平的准确性，这对于实际部署是一个关键的担忧。
motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作论文评分员，但其评估几乎完全依赖于一致性统计。教育测量学警告说，评分员在严苛性、光环效应和工具漂移方面也存在差异。本研究旨在将LLM评委视为评分员，进行更全面的审计。
method: 本研究将LLM评委视为评分员，并对两个语言（ENEM/Essay-BR; ASAP）的公共语料库（2,377篇论文，12位评委，4家提供商，5个版本对比）进行了预注册的评分员效应评估（多面Rasch严苛性、残余光环效应、泛化性/决策研究、跨版本变化、差异性功能）。
results: 评委严苛性在ENEM的0-1000分量表上跨越219点，在ASAP上占分数范围的15-33%，而训练有素的人类评分员差距接近1%。评委与人类的相关性处于0.47-0.56的无区分带。所有五个版本对比都使严苛性发生显著变化（高达133点）。一项评委在研究中途因身份问题被弃用。经严苛性调整的排行榜逆转未通过置换零假设检验。“静默漂移”被驳斥，一致性在五个对比中的四个中随严苛性变化。复制显示了自我一致性（k<=2时phi>=0.80），但未达到人类水平的准确性。在工具和校准匹配的情况下，没有可信证据表明评委的光环效应超过训练有素的人类范围。
conclusion: LLM评委在严苛性和版本稳定性方面表现出显著的变异性，可靠性中等，未能达到人类水平的准确性，尽管在受控条件下其光环效应可能不超过训练有素的人类。这强调了除了简单的一致性统计外，还需要对LLM进行更严格的全面审计。

title: Stimulated Oscillations in Renewable Energy Integrated Power Systems - Part II: Methodology of Oscillation Mitigation
authors: Peng Zhang
abstract: As presented in Part I of this series, closely located poles can produce high-amplitude oscillations even under small perturba-tions, which are referred to as stimulated oscillations. As the second installment of this series, this paper develops a method-ology for stimulated oscillation mitigation. Firstly, the logical relationship between system stability and oscillation risk is in-vestigated, clarifying that stability is neither a necessary nor a sufficient condition for oscillation risk. Secondly, the dominant factors affecting the pole and zero position on the complex plane, as well as their effectiveness and limitations are analyzed. For feedback control systems in particular, the influence of feedback paths on the pole-zero distribution of closed-loop systems is ana-lyzed. On this basis, a methodology for stimulated oscillation mitigation is proposed. Combined with the reduced-order trans-fer function of systems with closely separated poles, the order relation and configuration of poles and zeros for the feedback path transfer function, together with the criteria for gain selec-tion, are elaborated. Finally, a parameter tuning scheme for the poles, zeros and gain of the feedback path transfer function is presented. The proposed methodology for stimulated oscillation mitigation based on feedback control is not restricted to specific devices and can serve as a methodological reference for the design of diverse oscillation suppression schemes.
zh_title: 高比例新能源电力系统受激振荡——第二部分：振荡抑制方法论
translation: 正如本系列第一部分所述，紧密靠近的极点即使在小扰动下也能产生高振幅振荡，这被称为受激振荡。作为该系列的第二部分，本文开发了一种受激振荡抑制方法论。首先，研究了系统稳定性与振荡风险之间的逻辑关系，澄清了稳定性既不是振荡风险的必要条件也不是充分条件。其次，分析了影响复平面上极零点位置的主导因素及其有效性和局限性。特别针对反馈控制系统，分析了反馈路径对闭环系统极零点分布的影响。在此基础上，提出了受激振荡抑制方法论。结合具有紧密分离极点的系统的降阶传递函数，详细阐述了反馈路径传递函数的极零点阶数关系和配置，以及增益选择标准。最后，给出了反馈路径传递函数极点、零点和增益的参数整定方案。所提出的基于反馈控制的受激振荡抑制方法不局限于特定设备，可为各种振荡抑制方案的设计提供方法论参考。
tldr: 本文提出了基于反馈控制的新能源电力系统受激振荡抑制方法论，通过极零点配置和参数整定来有效缓解振荡风险，且不局限于特定设备。
ai_comments: 该论文是“受激振荡”系列研究的第二部分，专注于抑制方法。创新点在于通过分析闭环系统极零点分布，提出了一种基于反馈控制的通用振荡抑制方法，不局限于特定设备，具有较强的理论和工程参考价值。
motivation: 第一部分研究指出紧密靠拢的极点会导致高幅值的受激振荡，为了有效缓解和抑制这种由新能源并网引发的振荡风险，亟需开发一套系统化的振荡抑制方法论。
method: 首先研究系统稳定性与振荡风险的逻辑关系；其次分析影响复平面上极零点位置的主导因素及其局限性，特别是反馈路径对闭环系统极零点分布的影响；最后结合降阶传递函数，阐述反馈路径传递函数的极零点阶数关系、配置以及增益选择准则，并提出参数整定方案。
results: 明确了稳定性既不是振荡风险的必要条件也不是充分条件；阐明了反馈路径对极零点分布的影响规律；提出了针对受激振荡的反馈控制抑制方法及具体的参数整定方案。
conclusion: 本文提出的基于反馈控制的受激振荡抑制方法不依赖于特定设备，为各类电力系统振荡抑制方案的设计提供了通用的方法论参考。

title: Ontology-Guided Multi-Agent Extraction of Evaluation Objects from Academic Review Texts: Evidence from Chinese Library and Information Science
authors: Haolin Chen, Hongyi Dong, Yu Zhu, Yijia Hong, Leiqing Niu, Jiyuan Ye
abstract: Academic reviews, scholarly commentaries, and book reviews serve as sources of evaluative statements about theories, methods, literature, institutions, and policies, providing valuable evidence for scholarly evaluation. Existing scientific entity extraction methods mainly target research articles and are less effective for evaluation objects, which are often abstract, context-dependent, and characterized by ambiguous type boundaries. This study proposes an ontology-guided multi-agent framework for evaluation object extraction. The framework combines candidate discovery, ontology-constrained classification, and domain review. Experimental results show that it achieves a Precision of 90.33%, Recall of 84.55%, Entity-level F1 of 87.34%, Strict Typed F1 of 79.78%, and Type Accuracy of 91.35%, substantially outperforming rule-based and zero-shot baselines. Ablation results indicate that the multi-agent workflow improves recall and stability, while ontology-based boundary constraints enhance fine-grained classification and reduce category confusion. The framework supports the structured utilization of evaluative scholarly texts and provides methodological support for evidence-based research evaluation and STI mining.
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure; accepted at ASIS&T METSTI
zh_title: 基于本体论引导的多智能体学术评论文本评估对象抽取：来自中国图书馆与信息科学的证据
translation: 学术评论、学术评论文章和书评是关于理论、方法、文献、机构和政策的评估性陈述的来源，为学术评估提供了有价值的证据。现有的科学实体抽取方法主要针对研究论文，对评估对象的效果不佳，因为评估对象通常是抽象的、上下文相关的，并且具有模糊的类型边界。本研究提出了一个本体引导的多智能体框架，用于评估对象抽取。该框架结合了候选发现、本体约束分类和领域审查。实验结果表明，它取得了90.33%的精确率、84.55%的召回率、87.34%的实体级F1、79.78%的严格类型F1和91.35%的类型准确率，显著优于基于规则和零样本的基线方法。消融结果表明，多智能体工作流提高了召回率和稳定性，而基于本体的边界约束增强了细粒度分类并减少了类别混淆。该框架支持评估性学术文本的结构化利用，并为循证研究评估和科技信息挖掘提供方法学支持。
tldr: 现有方法难以从学术评论中有效抽取抽象的评估对象。本研究提出一个本体引导的多智能体框架，在中文图书馆与信息科学领域取得了显著优于基线方法的性能。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一个结合本体引导和多智能体工作流的框架，有效地解决了从学术评论文本中抽取抽象评估对象的挑战。其通过本体约束增强细粒度分类并减少类别混淆，通过多智能体提高召回率和稳定性，为学术评价和科技信息挖掘提供了有力的工具。
motivation: 学术评论是关于理论、方法、文献、机构和政策的评估性陈述的来源，为学术评估提供有价值的证据。然而，现有科学实体抽取方法主要针对研究论文，对评估对象（通常抽象、上下文依赖且类型边界模糊）效果不佳。
method: 本研究提出了一个本体引导的多智能体框架用于评估对象抽取。该框架结合了候选发现、本体约束分类和领域审查。
results: 实验结果显示，该框架的精确率为90.33%，召回率为84.55%，实体级F1为87.34%，严格类型F1为79.78%，类型准确率为91.35%，显著优于基于规则和零样本的基线方法。消融实验表明，多智能体工作流提高了召回率和稳定性，而基于本体的边界约束增强了细粒度分类并减少了类别混淆。
